===

身等第恭依

《天順八年進士登科錄》

玉音

禮部尚書臣姚夔等於西角門奏，為科舉事：天順七年會試天下舉人，取中二百四十七名。天順八年三月十五日殿試，合請讀卷及執事等官，少保、吏部尚書兼華蓋殿大學士李賢等四十三員。其進士出身等第，恭依太祖高皇帝欽定資格：第一甲例取三名，第一名從六品，第二、第三名正七品，賜進士及第；第二甲從七品，賜進士出身；第三甲正八品，賜同進士出身。奉聖旨：「是。欽此。」

讀卷官
榮祿大夫、少保、吏部尚書兼華蓋殿大學士李賢〔鄧州人，癸丑〕
translation_en:
Record of Successful Candidates in the Metropolitan and Palace Examinations of the Eighth Year of Tianshun (1464) (Tianshun ba nian jinshi dengke lu)

Imperial Pronouncement

The Minister of Rites, your servant Yao Kui 姚夔, and others presented a memorial at the West Corner Gate regarding the civil service examinations: In the Metropolitan Examination of the seventh year of Tianshun (1463) for provincial graduates (juren) from across the realm, 247 candidates were selected. For the Palace Examination on the fifteenth day of the third month of the eighth year of Tianshun (April 21, 1464), it is appropriate to request the appointment of forty-three officials to serve as Readers of Examination Papers and Officiating Officials, headed by Li Xian 李賢, Junior Guardian, Minister of Personnel, and concurrently Grand Secretary of the Huagai Hall. As for the grades and statuses conferred upon the metropolitan graduates (jinshi), we respectfully follow the qualifications imperially established by Emperor Taizu Gao: in the First Class (diyi jia), three candidates are selected by precedent—the first-placed candidate is accorded rank 6b, and the second- and third-placed candidates rank 7a, all granted the title of Jinshi with Honors (jinshi jidi); those in the Second Class (di'er jia) are accorded rank 7b and granted the title of Jinshi Graduate (jinshi chushen); those in the Third Class (disan jia) are accorded rank 8a and granted the title of Associate Jinshi Graduate (tong jinshi chushen). We received the Imperial Edict: "Approved. Respect this."

Readers of Examination Papers (dujuan guan)

Li Xian 李賢, Grandee of the Sixteenth Class, Junior Guardian, Minister of Personnel, and concurrently Grand Secretary of the Huagai Hall (a native of Dengzhou 鄧州; metropolitan graduate of the guichou year [1433]).

translation_en:
Order of Imperial Honors and Ceremonies

In the eighth year of the Tianshun era (1464), on the fifteenth day of the third month, the Tribute Students (gongshi) proceeded to the Inner Palace for the Palace Examination (dianshi). Reverently coinciding with the grand mourning rites for the Emperor Yingzong Rui, the Ministry [of Rites] had previously memorialized and received approval that ceremonial matters be simplified. Early on that day, the Tribute Students were led to the West Corner Gate (Xijiao men) to perform the ritual of five bows and three kowtows. Once completed, they proceeded into the Cinnabar Courtyard in front of the Hall of Revering Heaven (Fengtian dian) to await the policy question.

Early on the seventeenth day of the third month, the civil and military officials attended in court ranks wearing plain mourning dress, and the Emperor appeared at the West Corner Gate. The Court of State Ceremonial (Honglu si) raised the ceremonial table and placed it in the center, and the Hanlin Academy held up the Yellow Placard (huangbang) and handed it to the Ministry of Rites, which placed it on the table. The metropolitan graduates (jinshi), wearing the robes and caps of metropolitan graduates, performed the ritual of five bows and three kowtows. The Ministry of Rites held up the Yellow Placard—musical instruments were set out, but the music was not played—and led the procession out past the Left Chang'an Gate (Chang'an zuomen) to post it for public display. Once completed, the officials of Shuntian Prefecture, using ceremonial parasols and a retinue of attendants, …

translation_en:
…to escort the Optimus (zhuangyuan) back to his residence.

On the eighteenth day of the third month, the Optimus was bestowed an official cap and robe, and the metropolitan graduates (jinshi) were bestowed paper money (baochao).

On the nineteenth day of the third month, the Optimus and all the metropolitan graduates went to the Court of State Ceremonial (Honglusi) to rehearse the court rituals.

On the twentieth day of the third month, the Optimus led all the metropolitan graduates to the West Corner Gate (Xijiaomen) to submit a memorial expressing gratitude for Imperial grace.

On the twenty-first day of the third month, the Optimus led all the metropolitan graduates to the Temple of the Former Teacher Confucius to perform the ritual offering of vegetables (shicai). The Ministry of Rites (Libu) submitted a memorial requesting that an Imperial command be issued to the Ministry of Works (Gongbu) to erect a stone stele inscribed with their names at the Directorate of Education (Guozijian).

尚冕〔貫湖廣襄陽府棗陽縣軍籍，國子生，治《易經》，字從周，行一，年三十二，六月二十五日生〕。曾祖得仁，祖雲〔知縣〕，父聰〔兵馬副指揮〕，母杜氏。具慶下。弟昂、昇、果。娶任氏。湖廣鄉試第八十八名，會試第一百九十五名。

孫蕃〔貫直隸揚州府江都縣軍籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字維翰，行三，年三十四，二月十八日生〕。曾祖友道，祖仲安，父成之〔教諭〕，母龍氏。具慶下。兄蔭，弟蔓。娶焦氏。應天府鄉試第五名，會試第二百三十四名。
translation_en:
Qian Yue 錢鉞 (registered under a military household in the Hangzhou Front Guard in Zhejiang, a District Student of Qiantang County, specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu), courtesy name Dayong, seventh in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-seven, born on the sixteenth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Qian Xian, his grandfather was Qian Li, his father is Qian Zhen, and his mother is née Mo. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Qian Yuan, Qian Cong, Qian Bo, Qian Jian, Qian Lin, and Qian Qi, and his younger brother is Qian Zhang. He married née Wu. He placed 88th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 90th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lu Ji 盧璣 (registered under a civilian household in Songyang County, Chuzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang, a District Student, specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu), courtesy name Shunyong, second in seniority, aged twenty-nine, born on the twenty-second day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Lu Benli, his grandfather was Lu Wenwei, his father was Lu Chengxiu, and his mother was née Wang. Both his parents are deceased. His elder brother is Lu Zhang. He married née Wu. He placed 11th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 111th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shang Mian 尚冕 (registered under a military household in Zaoyang County, Xiangyang Prefecture, Huguang, a National University Student, specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing), courtesy name Congzhou, first in seniority, aged thirty-two, born on the twenty-fifth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Shang Deren, his grandfather was Shang Yun (District Magistrate), his father is Shang Cong (Vice Warden), and his mother is née Du. Both his parents are living. His younger brothers are Shang Ang, Shang Sheng, and Shang Guo. He married née Ren. He placed 88th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 195th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Sun Fan 孫蕃 (registered under a military household in Jiangdu County, Yangzhou Prefecture, Zhili, a National University Student, specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji), courtesy name Weihan, third in seniority, aged thirty-four, born on the eighteenth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Sun Youdao, his grandfather was Sun Zhong'an, his father is Sun Chengzhi (Instructor), and his mother is née Long. Both his parents are living. His elder brother is Sun Yin, and his younger brother is Sun Man. He married née Jiao. He placed 5th in the Yingtian Prefectural Examination and 234th in the Metropolitan Examination.

傅實〔貫江西南昌府豐城縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字璨輝，行四，年四十一，二月初二日生〕。曾祖景良，祖伯庸，父文顯，母余氏。慈侍下，弟璁輝、理輝，娶熊氏。江西鄉試第四十三名，會試第二百十五名。

李汝嘉〔貫福建泉州府晉江縣民籍，府學生，治《易經》，字士美，行一，年二十八，九月二十二日生〕。曾祖思聰，祖原貞，父敏肅，母王氏。具慶下，弟讃、訒、雋、瓛、儒、昂、嵩，娶□氏。福建鄉試第三十七名，會試第一百四十四名。
translation_en:
Zhang Fuhua 張敷華, registered under a civilian household in Anfu County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi, was a student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng) specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); his courtesy name was Gongshi, he was the second son in his generation, and he was twenty-six sui, born on the seventeenth day of the twelfth month. His great-grandfather was Zhang Shangxiu, his grandfather was Zhang Ruojin (formerly an Investigating Censor), his father was Zhang Hong (an Investigating Censor), and his mother was née Yao (invested as a Child-Nurturess, Ruren). Both his parents and grandparents were living (chongqing xia); he had an elder brother, Furong, and a younger brother, Fuying, and was married to née Lu. He placed 11th in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 19th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Yuan 周源, registered under a civilian household in Shangyuan County, Yingtian Prefecture, was a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); his courtesy name was Deyuan, he was the first son in his generation, and he was twenty-nine sui, born on the eighteenth day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Zhou Zhizhong, his grandfather was Zhou Yanwen (a Director in the Ministry of Revenue), his father was Zhou Jie, and his mother was née Huang. Both of his parents were living (juqing xia); he had younger brothers Gan, Qing, and Pu, and was married to née Mao. He placed 80th in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 141st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fu Shi 傅實, registered under a civilian household in Fengcheng County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi, was a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); his courtesy name was Canhui, he was the fourth son in his generation, and he was forty-one sui, born on the second day of the second month. His great-grandfather was Fu Jingliang, his grandfather was Fu Boyong, his father was Fu Wenxian, and his mother was née Yu. His mother was living and his father was deceased (cishi xia); he had younger brothers Conghui and Lihui, and was married to née Xiong. He placed 43rd in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 215th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Rujia 李汝嘉, registered under a civilian household in Jinjiang County, Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian, was a student of the Prefectural School specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); his courtesy name was Shimei, he was the first son in his generation, and he was twenty-eight sui, born on the twenty-second day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was Li Sicong, his grandfather was Li Yuanzhen, his father was Li Minsu, and his mother was née Wang. Both of his parents were living (juqing xia); he had younger brothers Zan, Ren, Juan, Huan, Ru, Ang, and Song, and was married to née [?]. He placed 37th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 144th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhao Hong 趙弘 (registered in a military household in Dao Subprefecture, Yongzhou Prefecture, Huguang; a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Hongdao; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the third day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Zhao Kekuan; his grandfather was Zhao Tingmei; his father is Zhao Kang (Instructor); and his mother is née Yin. Both of his parents are living; his younger brothers are Zhao Bi and Zhao Qiang; and he is married to née Zhou. He placed fourth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and one hundred eighty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zheng Ming 鄭銘 (registered in a civilian household in Handan County, Guangping Prefecture, Zhili; a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Documents [Shujing]; courtesy name Dexin; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-six, born on the thirtieth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Zheng Sizhong; his grandfather was Zheng Can; his father was Zheng Hong; his legal mother is née Wang, and his birth mother is née Wang. His mother is living and his father is deceased; his elder brother is Zheng Ju, and his younger brothers are Zheng Jian and Zheng Jin; and he is married to née He. He placed one hundred twenty-second in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and seventy-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ao He 敖和 (registered in a civilian household in Gao'an County, Ruizhou Prefecture, Jiangxi; a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Zhengle; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the thirteenth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Ao Boren; his grandfather was Ao Yonghui; his father was Ao Fuchuan; and his mother was née Fu. Both of his parents are deceased; his elder brother is Ao Zhenglun, and his younger brothers are Ao Zhengyi, Ao Zhengya, Ao Zhengyan, and Ao Zhengdian; and he is married to née Xu. He placed thirty-ninth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yao Bi 姚璧 (registered in a civilian household in Tonglu County, Yanzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Liangfu; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the eighth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Yao Bohua (posthumously honoured as Right Vice Minister of Rites); his grandfather was Yao Weishan (posthumously honoured as Right Vice Minister of Rites); his father is Yao Kui (Minister); and his mother is née Wang (invested as Lady of Virtue). Both of his parents are living; his younger brother is Yao Xi; and he is married to née Zhao. He placed seventy-eighth in the [illegible] Provincial Examination and [illegible] in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Zheng Yu 鄭玉 (registered under a craftsman household in Daxing County, Shuntian Prefecture; a Confucian scholar (rushi) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shiyong 時用; third in his generation; age thirty-three, born on the twenty-fourth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Zheng Wenxian 文顯, his grandfather was Zheng Shirong 士榮, his father was Zheng Jizong 繼宗, and his mother is née Gu 谷. His mother is living (cishi xia). His elder brothers are Zheng Hong 鋐 and Zheng Ji 錤, and he is married to a woman née Pan 潘. He placed 100th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 65th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yao Shou 姚綬 (registered under a military household in Jiaxing County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; a National University Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Gongshou 公綬; first in his generation; age forty-three, born on the third day of the intercalary twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Yao Ziying 子英, his grandfather was Yao Zhen 鎭, his father was Yao Kezhang 克章, and his mother is née Xu 許. His mother is living (cishi xia), and he is married to a woman née Hong 弘. He placed 3rd in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 74th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Zhi 楊智 (registered under a civilian household in Jinjiang County, Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian; a National University Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Siming 思明; second in his generation; age thirty-three, born on the twenty-second day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Yang Zicheng 子成, his grandfather was Yang Hui 惠, his father is Yang Guan 觀, his mother was née Wang 王, and his stepmother is née Li 李. Both his father and stepmother are living (juqing xia). His elder brother is Yang Rui 睿; his younger brothers are Yang Xin 信, Yang Min 敏, Yang Ning 寧, Yang Lin 璘, Yang Qi 琪, Yang Zhang 璋, and Yang Fan 璠; and he is married to a woman née Zhao 趙. He placed 83rd in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 43rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Ji 陳稢 (registered under a civilian household in Panyu County, Guangzhou Prefecture, Guangdong; a Prefectural School Student (fuxuesheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zhongfang 仲芳; first in his generation; age twenty-four, born on the second day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Chen Shouqing 壽卿, his grandfather was Chen Jingchang 景昌, his father is Chen Yuan 源, and his mother is née Zhou 周. Both his parents are living (juqing xia). His younger brothers are Chen Chou 稠 and Chen Ji 積, and he is betrothed to a woman née Liang 梁. He placed 37th in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and 161st in the Metropolitan Examination.

His great-grandfather was Wang Puda 王普逹; his grandfather was Wang Tinghuai 王庭槐; his father was Wang Yingzhen 王應禎, his principal mother was née Qian 錢氏, and his birth mother is née Bai 白氏. His mother is living while his father is deceased (cishixia). His elder brothers are Wang Zuo 王佐, Wang Ying 王瑛, and Wang Fu 王輔 [a National University Student (guozisheng)]; his younger brother is Wang Chong 王崇. He married née Jiang 姜氏. He placed 83rd in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 95th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ni Fu 倪輔 [registered in a commoner household in Pinghu County 平湖縣, Jiaxing Prefecture 嘉興府, Zhejiang 浙江; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Liangbi 良弼; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the fourth day of the ninth month]. He placed 13th in the Yingtian Prefectural 應天府 Provincial Examination and 143rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

He placed [two characters illegible] in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and [three characters illegible] in the Metropolitan Examination.

His great-grandfather was Yanwen 彥文; his grandfather was Shengbo 聲伯; his father was Tingfeng 廷奉; and his mother is née Lu 陸氏. His mother is living and his father is deceased (cishixia 慈侍下). His elder brothers are Hao 昊 and Xin 昕 (Public-spirited Officer 義官); his younger brothers are Xi 曦 (provincial graduate, juren), Chang 昌, Xuan 暄, Zhao 昭, Jin 晋, Shen 昚, Pu 普, and Ye 曄. He married née Wen 聞氏. He placed twenty-sixth in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and eightieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Mian 李冕 (registered in Jianzhou 劔州, Baoning Prefecture 保寧府, Sichuan 四川, under military household status; a Prefectural Student 府學生 specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Wenzhong 文中; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-five; born on the twenty-seventh day of the intercalary twelfth month). His younger brothers are Tan 談 and Zan 瓚. He married née Luo 羅氏. He placed sixty-ninth in the Sichuan 四川 Provincial Examination and seventeenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Min Gui 閔珪 (registered in Wucheng County 烏程縣, Huzhou Prefecture 湖州府, Zhejiang 浙江, under military household status; a Student of the Directorate of Education 國子生 specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Chaoying 朝瑛; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-five; born on the seventeenth day of the twelfth month). His younger brothers are Zhang 璋, Lin 琳, Qi 琪, Zhen 瑧, and Huang 璜. He married née Wang 王氏. He placed forty-fourth in the Zhejiang 浙江 Provincial Examination and fortieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

His great-grandfather was Deke 德可; his grandfather was Shengyuan 昇遠; his father was Yunyu 韞玉; and his mother is née Luo 羅氏. His mother is living and his father is deceased (cishixia 慈侍下). translation_en:
Ni Yue 倪岳 (native of Shangyuan County, Yingtian Prefecture, of artisan household registration; student of the Wanquan Regional Military Commission School, specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); style name Shunzi; first in seniority among brothers; age twenty-one, born on the twenty-third day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Derun; his grandfather was Zi'an (granted the title of Academician Expositor-in-waiting in the Hanlin Academy concurrently Companion in the Left Secretariat of the Heir Apparent); his father is Qian (Hanlin Academician); his mother was Lady Yao (invested as Lady of Suitability); and his stepmother is Lady Guo (invested as Lady of Suitability). His father is living. His younger brothers are Fu and Gao, and he is married to Lady Lu. He placed ninety-eighth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred forty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tang Sheng 唐盛 (native of Nanhai County, Guangzhou Prefecture, Guangdong, of civilian household registration; National University Student, specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Shilong; first in seniority among brothers; age thirty-seven, born on the sixth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Liangkai; his grandfather is Kongyu; his father is Sizhong; and his mother is Lady Guan. Both his grandparents and parents are living. His younger brothers are Zhen (Tribute Scholar) and Jian, and he is married to Lady Deng. He placed sixty-first in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and ninety-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Huaijing 劉懷經 (native of Fushun County, Xuzhou Prefecture, Sichuan, of civilian household registration; National University Student, specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); style name Shuli; second in seniority among brothers; age thirty-four, born on the first day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Bihe; his grandfather was Rong; his father is Maochun; his mother was Lady Liu; and his stepmother is Lady Hu. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Huainan and Huaihu; his younger brothers are Huaijun and Huairen; and he is married to Lady Wang. He placed thirtieth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and one hundredth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xie Duo 謝鐸 (native of Huangyan County, Taizhou Prefecture, Zhejiang, of civilian household registration; National University Student, specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Mingzhi; first in seniority among brothers; age thirty, born on the twenty-second day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Yuanzhu; his grandfather was Xingduan; his father is Shiyan; and his mother is Lady Gao. Both his parents are living. His younger brothers are Zhi, Zhu, Jian, and Yi, and he is married to Lady Chen. He placed thirty-first in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and two hundred thirty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Xiao Zhen 蕭禎 (native of Taihe County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi, of military household registration; a Confucian scholar (rushi) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yanxiang, fourth in seniority; aged thirty-three, born on the eighth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Tingweng; his grandfather was Weihan; his father was Chushen; his father's former wife was née Ouyang, and his mother was née Luo. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Yanheng, Yanqing, and Yanfang. He married née Zhou. He placed sixty-second in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and eighty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Gao Fei 高斐 (native of Yanshi County, Henan Prefecture, Henan, of civilian household registration; a National University Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Wenzhu, first in seniority; aged thirty-seven, born on the third day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Gui; his grandfather was Heng; his father is Jin (Administrator (zhangshi)); and his mother is née Chen. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Jing (a Cap-and-Belt Official (guandai guan)), Lun, and Qi. He married née Wang. He placed sixty-sixth in the Henan Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Qi 沈棨 (native of Pinghu County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, of saltern household registration; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes; courtesy name Yuanjie, third in seniority; aged thirty, born on the fifth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Zhen; his grandfather was Hao; his father is Wei; and his mother is née Song. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Yue and Mu; his younger brothers are Zhang, Ling, Gai, Heng, Gao, Ju, and Kai. He married née Gao. He placed twenty-eighth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and forty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Zhong 周重 (native of Anfu County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi, of civilian household registration; an Added Student (zengguang sheng) of the county school specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Ruding, sixth in seniority; aged thirty-one, born on the thirtieth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Lifu; his grandfather was Zilian; his father is Changchi; and his mother is née Peng. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Shaoli, Xili, and Boli [6 illegible characters, likely younger brothers and wife's surname]. He placed [3 illegible characters] in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and [5 illegible characters] in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lu Guang 陸廣 (courtesy name Dehong 德宏, fourth in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-eight, born on the twentieth day of the sixth month) was registered in a civilian household of Jiaxing County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, and was a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing). His great-grandfather was Lu Yonghe, his grandfather was Lu Yuqing, his father was Lu Mingshan, and his mother was née Jing. Both parents are living; he has elder brothers Lu Xin, Lu Yin, and Lu Shang, and a younger brother Lu Yuan, and is married to a woman née Xu. He placed sixty-seventh in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fan Run 范潤 (courtesy name Shize 時澤, third in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-seven, born on the ninth day of the second month) was registered in a civilian household of Yin County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang, and was a Prefectural School Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing). His great-grandfather was Fan Jinggao, his grandfather was Fan Bixian, his father was Fan Yong, and his mother was née Zhu. Both parents are living; he has elder brothers Fan Hao and Fan Han (a Tribute Student, gongshi), and younger brothers Fan Qi, Fan Xiang, and Fan Yuan, and is married to a woman née Chai. He placed twenty-seventh in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and forty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Guo Xi 郭璽 (courtesy name Wenrui 文瑞, fifth in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-five, born on the twentieth day of the fifth month) was registered in a military household of Chengwu County, Yanzhou Prefecture, Shandong, and was a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing). His great-grandfather was Guo Yanli, his grandfather was Guo Sheng, his father was Guo Hao, his late mother was née Liu, and his mother is née Jia. His mother is living; he has elder brothers Guo Ying (an Attendant Tutor, Jishan), Guo Qi, Guo Huang, and Guo Min, and younger brothers Guo Pu, Guo Cong, Guo Yu, Guo Qi, Guo Xuan, and Guo Ju, and is married to a woman née Liu. He placed fifty-fourth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and two hundred fiftieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jiao Fang 焦芳 (courtesy name Mengyang 孟陽, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty, born on the thirteenth day of the seventh month) was registered in a civilian household of Biyang County, Nanyang Prefecture, Henan, and was a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu). His great-grandfather was Jiao Cheng, his grandfather was Jiao Xian (a Prefectural Instructor, Jiaoshou), his father was Jiao Xuan, and his mother was née Wei. Both parents are living; he has a younger brother Jiao Lan, and is married to a woman née Lü. He placed seventy-eighth in the Henan Provincial Examination and one hundred seventy-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Zhao Kan 趙侃 (ancestral home Jiading County 嘉定縣, Southern Metropolitan Area 直隸; registered in an official household of the Puding Guard 普定衛, Guizhou 貴州; National University Student, specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zhigang 至剛; fourth in seniority among brothers; aged forty, born on the fourteenth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Zhao Wenzheng 文政; his grandfather was Zhao Xingfu 興甫; his father was Zhao Hua 華; his mother was née Dong 董, and his stepmother was née Zhu 朱. His stepmother is living. His elder brothers are Zhao Jun 俊, Zhao Jie 傑, and Zhao Wei 偉; his younger brother is Zhao Fen 份. He married née Lin 林. He placed 2nd in the Yunnan 雲南 Provincial Examination and 30th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Hu Gong 胡恭 (registered in a military household of Yuyao County 餘姚縣, Shaoxing Prefecture 紹興府, Zhejiang 浙江; Added Student in the county school, specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Kejing 克敬; third in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the fourteenth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Hu Simin 思敏; his grandfather was Hu Runchu 閏初; his father is Hu Kuan 寬; his mother was née Zheng 鄭, and his stepmother is née Wang 王. Both his father and stepmother are living. His elder brothers are Hu Ming 明 and Hu Hong 弘; his younger brothers are Hu Yan 儼, Hu Lun 倫, Hu Zan 贊, and Hu Quan 銓 (Official Awaiting Appointment). He married née Yan 嚴. He placed 84th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 25th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tang Ren 唐仁 (registered in a Confucian scholar household of Da County 達縣, Kuizhou Prefecture 夔州府, Sichuan 四川; National University Student, specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Bingyuan 秉元; first in seniority among brothers; aged forty, born on the seventeenth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Tang Yu 瑜 (Administrative Clerk); his grandfather was Tang Kun 鯤 (provincial graduate, juren); his father is Tang Xian 憲 (National University Student Awaiting Appointment); his mother was née Liu 柳, and his stepmother is née Li 黎. Both his father and stepmother are living. His younger brothers are Tang Lun 倫, Tang Zuo 佐, Tang You 佑, Tang Xin 信, and Tang Guan 倌. He married née Zhou 周. He placed 86th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 16th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Sun Yi 孫義 (ancestral home Shangyuan County 上元縣, Yingtian Prefecture 應天府; registered in a physician household of the Imperial Academy of Medicine 太醫院; National University Student, specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yifang 以方; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the fifteenth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Sun Juexiang 覺祥; his grandfather was Sun Dezhong 得中; his father is Sun Rang 讓 (Medical Practitioner); his mother was née Wu 吳, and his stepmother is née Yang 楊. Both his father and stepmother are living. He married née Meng 孟. He placed 40th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 162nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Xu Zhang 許章 [registered in a commoner household of Jiaxing County 嘉興縣, Jiaxing Prefecture 嘉興府, Zhejiang 浙江; Directorate Student (guozisheng); specialized in the Book of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Tingmian 廷冕; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-three sui, born on the eleventh day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Xu Xiang 祥; his grandfather was Xu Heng 衡; his father was Xu Run 潤, and his mother was née Hu 胡氏. His mother is living; his younger brothers are Xu Lin 璘, Xu Pu 璞, and Xu Rong 瑢. He married a woman née Yao 姚氏. He placed sixteenth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and fiftieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Peng Xu 彭序 [registered in a military household of Luling County 廬陵縣, Ji'an Prefecture 吉安府, Jiangxi 江西; Directorate Student (guozisheng); specialized in the Book of Odes (Shijing); courtesy name Zhaolun 昭倫; third in seniority among his brothers; aged forty-three sui, born on the twelfth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Peng Lizheng 立政; his grandfather was Peng Huize 惠則; his father was Peng Dizhong 迪中, and his mother was née Liu 劉氏. His mother is living; his elder brothers are Peng Zhaoxian 昭憲 and Peng Zhaoyi 昭彝. He married a woman née Long 龍氏, and remarried a woman née Wu 吳氏. He placed first in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and fifty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhao Sheng 趙勝 [registered in a commoner household of Yiwu County 義烏縣, Jinhua Prefecture 金華府, Zhejiang; County Student; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Tingshen 廷伸; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one sui, born on the twenty-fifth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhao Boda 伯達; his grandfather was Zhao Yuanzhen 原貞; his father was Zhao Zhongyuan 仲遠, and his mother was née Wu 吳氏. His mother is living; his younger brother is Zhao Pucheng 普成. He married a woman née Wu 吳氏. He placed fifth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred and fortieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yu Yao 虞瑤 [registered in a commoner household of Jinyun County 縉雲縣, Chuzhou Prefecture 處州府, Zhejiang; County Student; specialized in the Book of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Bangqiong 邦瓊; ninth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight sui, born on the twenty-fourth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Yu Chenzhong 辰仲; his grandfather was Yu Xianglian 祥廉; his father is Yu Kun 崑, his mother was née Fan 范氏, and his stepmother is [illegible]. Both parents are living; his elder brother is Yu Gai 垓, and his younger brothers are Yu Pei 培 and Yu Zeng 增. He married a woman née Li 李氏. He placed forty-second in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred and seventy-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Pan Ju 潘琚 (registered in a civilian household of Jinhua County, Jinhua Prefecture, Zhejiang; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Tingyong; fourth in his generation; age twenty-six, born on the nineteenth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Pan Zhongde; his grandfather was Pan Shike; his father is Pan Hui; and his mother is née Zhu. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Pan Jin (a Medical Practitioner) and Pan Zhen. He married née Zhao, and subsequently married née Fang. He placed 31st in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 181st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Qing 陳清 (registered in a military household of Yidu County, Qingzhou Prefecture, Shandong; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Lianfu; second in his generation; age twenty-seven, born on the twenty-third day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Chen Youcai; his grandfather was Chen Yi; his father is Chen Jun (a County Instructor); and his mother is née Zhou. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Chen Yuan. He married née Cao, and subsequently married née Zhang. He placed 30th in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 139th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Di 李迪 (a native of Fugou County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan, registered in an official household of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Yongji; first in his generation; age thirty-two, born on the twentieth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Li Shizhong; his grandfather was Li Yongfu (a Guard Ceremonial Manager in the Embroidered-Uniform Guard); his father is Li Ning (a Platoon Commander in the Embroidered-Uniform Guard); and his mother is née Chang. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Li Xun (a Houseman with Cap and Belt), Li Yu, and Li Dao. He married née Xia. He placed 99th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 77th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liang Jin 梁謹 (registered in a civilian household of Wucheng County, Gaotang Subprefecture, Dongchang Prefecture, Shandong; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Jingzhi; first in his generation; age thirty-seven, born on the eleventh day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Liang Xing; his grandfather was Liang Yong (an Investigating Censor); his father is Liang Duan (an Instructor in the Directorate of Education); and his mother is née Chen. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Liang Jie, Liang Cheng, Liang Qian (a Tribute Student), and Liang Yi. He married née Huo, and subsequently married née Zhang. He placed 38th in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 208th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Wang Yang 汪洋 (ancestral home Qianshan County, Anqing Prefecture, Directly Attached [Zhili], registered in a military household of the Yanshan Front Guard; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Wenyuan; first in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-four, born on the twentieth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Daohong; his grandfather was Xin; his father was Fu (Secretary in the Ministry of Justice); and his mother is née Feng. His mother is living. His younger brother is Han. He is betrothed to a woman née Mei. He placed seventy-sixth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred sixty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Qiu Hong 丘弘 (registered in a commoner household in Shanghang County, Tingzhou Prefecture, Fujian; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Kuanshu; third in seniority among brothers; aged forty, born on the twenty-sixth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Liangzuo; his grandfather was Cundao; his father was Lingzong; and his mother was née Lei. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Yan (Assistant Instructor), Hong, and Hao. He married a woman née Zheng. He placed second in the Fujian Provincial Examination and two hundred nineteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Gong Ying 龔膺 (registered in a commoner household in Ningde County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Weishan; fourth in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-eight, born on the eighteenth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Ziming; his grandfather was Zehui; his father was Yu; his mother was née Chen, and his stepmother is née Zheng. His stepmother is living. His younger brothers are Qing, Tang, Zhuang, and Ting. He married a woman née Cui, and remarried a woman née Lin. He placed eighty-second in the Fujian Provincial Examination and sixty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Pan Rufu 潘汝輔 (registered in a commoner household in Huai'an County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Rubi; tenth in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-eight, born on the eighteenth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Jingbi; his grandfather was Mingyuan; his father is Weishen (Vice Magistrate); and his mother was née Li. His father is living. His elder brothers are Rumao and Ruhe; his younger brothers are Ruda, Ruji, and Rufan. He married a woman née Ma. He placed thirty-second in the Fujian Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

His great-grandfather was Chen Zongyi, his grandfather was Chen Guangyuan, his father was Chen Chongcheng, and his mother was née Huang. Both of his parents are deceased. His younger brothers are Chen Zu, Chen Yuan, and Chen Kui. He married née Huang, and remarried née Lin. He placed 44th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 11th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Xuan 周瑄 (registered in a civilian household in Wu County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Liangbi; seniority second; age twenty-seven, born on the tenth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Zhou Zhongli, his grandfather was Zhou Qian, his father is Zhou Wu, and his mother was née Yu. His father is living and his mother is deceased. His elder brother is Zhou Cong. He married née Shen. He placed 118th in the Yingtian Prefectural [Provincial] Examination and 32nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Jin 張謹 (registered in a civilian household in Dingyuan County, Fengyang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; National University Student; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Shenzhi; seniority first; age thirty-four, born on the fourteenth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Daoheng, his grandfather is Zhang Qiong, his father is Zhang Yu, and his mother is née Cui. Both his grandparents and his parents are living. His younger brothers are Zhang Liang and Zhang Jian. He married née Li. He placed 183rd in the Yingtian Prefectural [Provincial] Examination and 46th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Zi 汪鎡 (registered in a military household in Shanyin County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shiyong; seniority third; age twenty-eight, born on the twenty-first day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Wang Ziwen, his grandfather was Wang Boling, his father was Wang Hui, and his mother is née Xie. His mother is living and his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Wang Lin and Wang Rui. He married née Fu. He placed 55th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 24th in the Metropolitan Examination.

His grandparents and parents are living (重慶下); his elder brothers are Wu Xun 遜 and Wu Sen 森 [Secretary in the Ministry of Rites, 禮部主事], his younger brothers are Wu Heng 亨, Wu Qian 乾, Wu Zhen 震, Wu Guang 光, and Wu Tai 泰, and he married Lady Lin 林氏. Huang Xi 黃熙 [registered in a military household in Changle County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian; Student of […]; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Ruming; eighth in seniority among his brothers; age forty-six, born on the […] day of the […] month]. His great-grandfather was Zhongyang [posthumously honored as Subprefectural Magistrate], his grandfather was Tong [Subprefectural Magistrate], his father was Chun, his father's former wife was née Li, and his mother is née Chen. Yu Ze 俞澤 [registered in a civilian household in Tonglu County, Yanzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; County Student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Yizhi; eighth in seniority among his brothers; age thirty-three, born on the fifth day of the eighth month]. He married née Yu. He placed 6th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 204th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yu Xi 余璽 [a native of Ba County, Sichuan, registered in an official military household of the Yiyong Vanguard Guard; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shiyong; sixth in seniority among his brothers; age twenty-eight, born on the twelfth day of the twelfth month]. His elder brothers are Zhen [Battalion Commander], Ying, Xuan, Qi, Zan, and Qing. He married née Gao, remarried née Chen, and is betrothed to née Huang. He placed 26th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 89th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Guo Rui 郭瑞 [registered in a civilian household in Jishui County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; Added County Student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Fengzhen; first in seniority in his line; age thirty-three, born on the thirtieth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Jiheng, his grandfather was Wenguan, his father was Xunzan, and his mother is née Mao. His mother is living. His elder cousins/brothers are Wanji, Zaiji, Fengji, and Fengshao. He married née Hu. He placed 48th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 136th in the Metropolitan Examination.

His great-grandfather was Xiangfu 祥甫; his grandfather was Tianlu 添禄; his father was Zhixian 志賢 (Assistant Instructor); his father's former wife was Lady Wang 王氏, his mother was Lady Li 李氏, and his stepmother is Lady Qiu 丘氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Duo 鐸, Jue 珏, Qiong 瓊, and Yue 嶽. He married Lady Bao 包氏. He placed 37th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 155th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Yan 張鶠 (registered as a commoner of Jishui County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Chongju 冲舉; second in seniority; aged thirty-four, born on the fifth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Fangcun 方存; his grandfather was Banggu 邦固; his father is Anzhi 安止; his mother is Lady Xiao 蕭氏. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Peng 鵬; his younger brothers are Hong 鴻, Feng 鳳, and E 鵝. He married Lady Guo 郭氏. He placed 91st in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 60th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhai Xuan 翟瑄 (native of Luoyang County, Henan, registered in the physician household of the Imperial Academy of Medicine; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Tingrui 廷瑞; first in seniority; aged thirty-two, born on the tenth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Bochang 伯常 (Principal of a Medical School); his grandfather was Lei 壘 (Medical Practitioner); his father is Guan 觀 (Imperial Physician); his mother is Lady Pang 龐氏. Both parents are living. His younger brother is Ying 瑛 (Tribute Student [gongshi]). He married Lady Pan 潘氏. He placed 236th in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination and 61st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Zhuang 陳壯 (native of Shanyin County, Zhejiang, registered in a military household of the Left Guard of the Regency; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zhifu 直夫; third in seniority; aged twenty-eight, born on the twenty-fourth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Puyi 普一; his grandfather was Gui 珪; his father is Jian 簡; his mother is Lady Yu 余氏. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Xiong 雄 and Yong 勇. He placed 118th in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination [line incomplete in original].

蕭彥莊〔貫江西吉安府泰和縣，儒籍，縣學生，治《書經》，字彥莊，行四，年三十，八月十九日生〕。曾祖士敏；祖瑱仲；父季脩；母嚴氏。重慶下。兄彥立〔訓導〕、彥敬〔通判〕、彥栗；弟彥選、彥德、彥喬、彥都、彥薦、彥謐。娶王氏。江西鄉試第十四名，會試第一百六十九名。
葉琦〔貫直隸徽州府祁門縣，民籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字廷圭，行三，年三十，三月初七日生〕。曾祖希元；祖汝舟；父孟頤；母潘氏。具慶下。兄寬、寧；弟□。娶周氏，繼娶□□。應天府鄉試第一名，會試第□□□名。
translation_en:
Wu Xiyuan 伍希淵: A native of Anfu County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi, registered in a civilian household; an added student of the county school specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Mengxian, first in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-eight, born on the seventh day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was Wu Shujing; his grandfather was Wu Mian (District Magistrate, posthumously conferred the title of Investigating Censor); his father is Wu Tixiang; his deceased biological mother was née Liu; and his stepmother is née Liu. Both parents (father and stepmother) are living. His younger brothers are Xidan, Xiyu, Xiji, Ximin (tribute student [gongshi]), and Xizhou. He married née Liu. He placed 82nd in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 4th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Jian 周鑑: A native of Guiji County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, registered in a military household; a student of the prefectural school specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Kongming, fourth in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-five, born on the second day of the intercalary twelfth month. His great-grandfather was Zhou Yanxiang; his grandfather was Zhou Huafu; his father is Zhou Wang; his father's former wife was née Bao; and his mother is née Yang. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Jin, Yin, and Qian; his younger brothers are Luan, E, and Yu. He married née Ma. He placed 12th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 150th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiao Yanzhuang 蕭彥莊: A native of Taihe County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi, registered in a Confucian scholar household; a student of the county school specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Yanzhuang, fourth in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty, born on the nineteenth day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Xiao Shimin; his grandfather is Xiao Tianzhong; his father is Xiao Jixiu; and his mother is née Yan. Both parents and grandparents are living. His elder brothers are Yanli (Assistant Instructor), Yanjing (Assistant Prefect), and Yanli; his younger brothers are Yanxuan, Yande, Yanqiao, Yandu, Yanjian, and Yanmi. He married née Wang. He placed 14th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 169th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ye Qi 葉琦: A native of Qimen County, Huizhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), registered in a civilian household; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Tinggui, third in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty, born on the seventh day of the third month. His great-grandfather was Ye Xiyuan; his grandfather was Ye Ruzhou; his father is Ye Mengyi; and his mother is née Pan. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Kuan and Ning; his younger brother is [one illegible character]. He married née Zhou, and remarried [two illegible characters]. He placed 1st in the Yingtian Prefectural Examination and [three illegible characters] in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Third Tier (Disanjia), 169 candidates, conferred the status of Associate Metropolitan Graduate (Tong jinshi chushen).

Zhang Da 張達 [registered in a commoner household in Taihe County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; National University Student (Guozisheng); specialized in the Book of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Shida 時達; sixth in seniority among brothers; age thirty-three, born on the eleventh day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Zongzhen 宗震, his grandfather was Yuejing 曰敬, his father was Shimei 士美, and his mother is née Wu 吳. His mother is living (cishixia). His elder brothers are Shizhan 時沾, Shiji 時濟, Shijun 時濬, Shiqi 時啓 [all Directorate Students (Jiansheng)], and Shijing 時警 [tribute student (Gongshi)]; his younger brother is Shiyu 時遇. He married née Luo 羅. He placed 88th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 172nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Jin 李進 [registered in a commoner household in Qingyuan County, Baoding Prefecture, Southern/Northern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); County Student (Xianxuesheng); specialized in the Book of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Tingyong 廷用; third in seniority among brothers; age thirty-four, born on the twenty-second day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Minyuan 敏原, his grandfather was Shouzhong 守中, his father was Xin 信, and his mother is née Zhang 張. His mother is living (cishixia). His elder brothers are Jing 敬 and Jin 謹. He married née Shi 石, and took née Xu 徐 as his second wife. He placed 33rd in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 23rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ji Li 計禮 [registered in a commoner household in Fuliang County, Raozhou Prefecture, Jiangxi; County Student (Xianxuesheng); specialized in the Book of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Ruhe 汝和; fifth in seniority among brothers; age thirty-four, born on the twelfth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Benshan 本善 [Instructor (Jiaoyu)], his grandfather was Yue 岳 [Assistant Instructor (Xundao)], his father is Yong 永 [Instructor (Jiaoyu)], his father's former wife was née Feng 馮, and his mother was née Chen 陳. His father is living (yanshixia). His elder brothers are Cheng 成 and Chang 昌 [Department Magistrate (Zhizhou)], and his younger brothers are You 祐, Fu 福, and Qi 祺. He married née Wang 王. He placed 1st in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 62nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Lang 楊琅 [native of Putian County 莆田縣, Xinghua Prefecture 興化府, Fujian 福建, of military household registration; National University Student, specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Chaozhong 朝重, third in generational seniority, aged thirty-seven, born on the sixteenth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Da-wu 大五, his grandfather was Yunde 允德, his father was Wenxian 文獻, and his mother was née Lin 林氏. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Lin 琳 and Ying 瑛, and his younger brothers are Gan 玕, Tian 瑱, and Duo 鐸. He married a woman née Lin 林氏, and subsequently married a woman née Chen 陳氏. He ranked first in the Fujian Provincial Examination and thirty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fu Han 傅瀚 [native of Xinyu County 新喻縣, Linjiang Prefecture 臨江府, Jiangxi 江西, of civilian household registration; National University Student, specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yuechuan 曰川, first in generational seniority, aged thirty, born on the twenty-third day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Yuanxian 原顯, his grandfather was Ruqi 汝器, his father is Bangben 邦本, and his mother is née Jian 簡氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Chun 淳 and Chao 潮. He married a woman née Li 李氏. He ranked twenty-fifth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred thirty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Hu Shen 胡深 [native of Xinjian County 新建縣, Jiangxi 江西, of military household registration in the Dingliao Rear Guard 定遼後衛 in Liaodong 遼東; National University Student, specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Yidao 以道, fourth in generational seniority, aged thirty-two, born on the ninth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Xiangqing 祥卿, his grandfather was Furen 福仁, his father was Jingquan 景泉, his mother was née Cheng 程氏, and his stepmother was née Zhou 周氏. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Sheng 盛, Yuan 源, and Cheng 澄. He married a woman née Bai 白氏. He ranked twenty-seventh in the Shandong Provincial Examination and twelfth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Deng 王璒 [native of Daxing County 大興縣, Shuntian Prefecture 順天府, of civilian household registration; National University Student, specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Qizhi 器之, third in generational seniority, aged twenty-eight, born on the twenty-ninth day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Cheng 成, his grandfather was Fushun 福順, his father is Xun 勛 [Prefectural Director of Schools], and his mother is née Meng 孟氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Zeng 增 and Ping 玶 [Tribute Student (gongshi)]. He married a woman née Yue 岳氏. He ranked fifty-seventh in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and eighty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Yuan Hao 袁鎬 (registered as a commoner of Fengcheng County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents [Shujing]; courtesy name Xuanzhou; eighth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-six, born on the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Yuan Guirong; his grandfather was Yuan Cheng (Supervising Secretary in the Office of Scrutiny for Personnel); his father is Yuan Chen; and his mother is née Hua. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Yuan Jian; his younger brothers are Yuan Lu and Yuan Kai. He is married to née Xia. He placed seventy-seventh in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred forty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Chong 王崇 (registered as a commoner of Linhai County, Taizhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; National University Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Shangde; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-seven, born on the twenty-fifth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Wang Bobei; his grandfather was Wang Zipi; his father is Wang Gongmian; and his mother is née Zheng. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Wang Zheng, Wang Yi, Wang Song, Wang Xiu, Wang Yao, and Wang Rong. He is married to née Hong. He placed fourth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred sixty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Hong Qing 洪清 (originally from Huaining County, Metropolitan Area [Zhili], registered in an hereditary officer household of the Wucheng Vanguard Guard; Tribute Student from the Shuntian Prefectural School; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Weizhi; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the fourth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Hong Juezong (Commander under the Yuan dynasty); his grandfather was Hong Zichun; his father was Hong Liang (posthumously honored as Commandant of Resplendent Trust); and his mother is née Cheng (invested as Grand Mistress of Peace). His father is deceased and his mother is living. His elder brothers are Hong Hai (Platoon Commander) and Hong Yuan. He is married to née Chen. He placed forty-ninth in the Shuntian Provincial Examination and one hundred forty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ding Chuan 丁川 (registered as a commoner of Xinchang County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Darong; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the eleventh day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Ding Yanding; his grandfather was Ding Qingliang; his father was Ding Mengda (Assistant Instructor); and his mother is née Shi. His father is deceased and his mother is living. His elder brothers are Ding Pi, Ding Lei, and Ding Dian; his younger brothers are Ding Lü, Ding Xu, and Ding Shuang. He is married to née Huang. He placed thirty-eighth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Shi 王軾: registered in a civilian household of Gong'an County, Jingzhou Prefecture, Huguang; a [?] Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Yongjing, first in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-six, born on the twentieth day of the ninth month. Both parents are living; his younger brothers are Wan, Yue, and Ke; he is married to a woman née Zhang. He placed 73rd in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 116th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Hongmi 吳宏密: registered in a military household of Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian; a Confucian scholar (rushi) specializing in the Classic of Documents; courtesy name Shenfu, second in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty, born on the twentieth day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Gongshuo, his grandfather was Demao, his father is Tishu, and his mother is née Liang. Both parents are living; his elder brother is Hongjian, and his younger brothers are Zhang, Hongshu, Ji, Zhi, Xin, and Yao; he is married to a woman née Liang. He placed 27th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 88th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Gong 楊恭: registered in a civilian household of Qishan County, Fengxiang Prefecture, Shaanxi; a National University Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Documents; courtesy name Kejing, first in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-eight, born on the twenty-ninth day of the first month. His great-grandfather was Qing, his grandfather was Xian, his father was Furong, and his mother was née Fu. Both parents are deceased; he is married to a woman née Wang. He placed 47th in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 221st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ruan Qi 阮玘: registered in a civilian household of Anfu County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; a Confucian scholar specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Tingyong, fifth in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-nine, born on the thirtieth day of the fifth month. His great-grandfather was Zhongsu, his grandfather was Xianfu, his father is Guangwei, and his mother is née Liu. Both parents are living; his elder brothers are Chen and Zhuo, and his younger brothers are Yu, Ke, and Ying; he is married to a woman née Wei. He placed 35th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 135th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhao Gang 趙綱 (courtesy name Zhenji 振紀, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty, born on the twelfth day of the tenth month) was registered in a military household in Jining Subprefecture, Yanzhou Prefecture, Shandong, and was a Subprefectural Student specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji). His great-grandfather was Zhao Wenshan, his grandfather was Zhao Yunsheng, his father was Zhao Kegong (Unranked Subofficial Jail Warden), and his mother was née Wang. His mother was still living; he had younger brothers Jin and Shen, and was married to née Sun. He placed thirty-ninth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and sixty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Hou Xiang 侯祥 (courtesy name Yuanji 元吉, fourth in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-five, born on the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month) was registered in a military household in Yizhou Subprefecture, Baoding Prefecture, Zhili, and was a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing). His great-grandfather was Hou Delin, his grandfather was Hou Yu, his father was Hou Xun, and his mother was née Lu. His mother was still living; he had elder brothers Fang, Xun, and Zhi, and was married to née Yang. He placed two hundred and fifteenth in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and forty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ma Xuan 馬暶 (courtesy name Deming 德明, fourth in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-two, born on the first day of the third month) was registered in a saltern household in Pinghu County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, and was a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing). His great-grandfather was Ma Anwu, his grandfather was Ma Zhi, his father was Ma Sheng, his father's former wife was née Lu, and his mother was née Yu. Both of his parents were living; he had elder brothers Wei, Hao, and Xi, and married née Gu and subsequently née Cui. He placed ninety-fourth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and two hundred and eleventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Duan Yu 段譽 (courtesy name Deshi 德實, fifth in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-six, born on the seventh day of the eighth month) was registered in a military household in Suning County, Hejian Prefecture, Zhili, and was a Directorate Student specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji). His great-grandfather was Duan Fuyuan, his grandfather was Duan Wenxiu, his father was Duan Zheng (Unranked Subofficial Jail Warden), and his mother was née Wang. His mother was still living; he had elder brothers Qian, Yin, Rang (Directorate Student), and Yi (Directorate Student), and was married to née Cai. He placed fourth in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and one hundred and seventy-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Jiang Hao 姜浩 (originally from Shanghai County 上海縣 in the Southern Metropolitan Area 直隸, registered in a military household of the Left Shenwu Guard 神武左衛; Confucian scholar; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Ximeng 希孟; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-two; born on the twentieth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Jiang Liang 良, his grandfather was Jiang Sheng 勝, his father is Jiang Wang 旺, and his mother is née Dai 戴氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brother is Jiang Qing 清. He is betrothed to née Ji 計氏. He placed 19th in the Shuntian Prefectural 順天府 Provincial Examination and 149th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Daxia 劉大夏 (registered in a military household of Huarong County 華容縣 in Yuezhou Prefecture 岳州府, Huguang 湖廣; student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Shiyong 時雍; eleventh in seniority among his brothers and cousins; aged twenty-nine; born on the twenty-fifth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Liu Bihong 必弘, his grandfather was Liu Xingjian 行簡, his father is Liu Renzhai 仁宅 ( Surveillance Vice Commissioner), and his mother is née Yan 嚴氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Liu Dazhong 大中, and his younger brothers are Liu Daqi 大奇 and Liu Dachun 大椿. He married née Lü 呂氏, and is subsequently betrothed to née Fu 傅氏. He placed 1st in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 28th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Shixiao 劉時斆 (registered in a civilian household of Neijiang County 內江縣 in Chengdu Prefecture 成都府, Sichuan 四川; student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Yongxing 用行; sixth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty; born on the twenty-fifth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Liu Dexian 得賢, his grandfather was Liu Youyi 友義, his father is Liu Jian 鑑, and his mother is née Zeng 曾氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Liu Shixue 時學 (Tribute Student), Liu Shitai 時泰, Liu Shilian 時廉, Liu Shixi 時習, Liu Shiliang 時良, and Liu Shiwan 時萬. He married née Tian 田氏. He placed 2nd in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 57th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zeng Jian 曾鑑 (originally from Guiyang County 桂陽縣, Huguang 湖廣, registered in an official military household of the Right Huben Guard 虎賁右衛; student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Keming 克明; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one; born on the twenty-third day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Zeng Minyuan 民遠, his grandfather was Zeng Deshou 得壽, his father is Zeng Rang 讓, and his mother is née Ai 艾氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Zeng Yi 鎰 (Battalion Commander), and his younger brothers are Zeng Yong 鏞, Zeng Quan 銓, Zeng Yue 鉞, and Zeng Zhong 鐘. He married née Chen 陳氏. He placed 45th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 138th in the Metropolitan Examination.

His great-grandfather was Yang Hui 惠; his grandfather was Yang Liang 良; his father is Yang Keyi 克義; his father's former wife was née Chen 陳氏; and his mother is née Cao 曹氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Yang Chenggang 成岡; his younger brothers are Yang Sheng 陞 [Honorary Official], Yang Di 隄, and Yang Bian 窆 [?]; and he married née Lin 林氏. He placed 48th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 96th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zheng Gong 鄭恭 [native of Quwo County 曲沃縣, Pingyang Prefecture 平陽府, Shanxi 山西, of military registration, National University Student, specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu), courtesy name Sijing 思敬, first in seniority among brothers, age thirty-four, born on the twelfth day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Zheng Daiyong 待用 [posthumously honored as Prefectural Judge]; his grandfather is Zheng Tan 談 [Prefectural Judge]; his father is Zheng Xuan 瑄; and his mother is née Wang 王氏. Both of his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brother is Zheng Xin 信, and he married née Li 李氏. He placed 57th in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 153rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Xun 李勳 [native of Anfu County 安福縣, Ji'an Prefecture 吉安府, Jiangxi 江西, of commoner registration, National University Student, specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing), courtesy name Maolie 茂烈, third in seniority among brothers, age twenty-nine, born on the twenty-eighth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Li Shizong 仕宗; his grandfather was Li Youzhi 友直; his father is Li Weixing 惟省; his father's former wife was née Liu 劉氏; and his mother is née Guo 郭氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Li Maojian 茂堅 and Li Maoshi 茂實, and he married née Luo 羅氏. He placed 8th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 207th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zheng Guan 鄭觀 [native of Min County 閩縣, Fuzhou Prefecture 福州府, Fujian 福建, of commoner registration, Prefectural Student, specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu), courtesy name Jianzhong 建中, third in seniority among brothers, age twenty-eight, born on the twenty-sixth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Zheng Fan 璠 [posthumously honored as Secretary in the Ministry of War]; his grandfather was Zheng Shu 塾 [Secretary in the Ministry of War]; his father is Zheng Yuan 垣 [Assistant Instructor]; and his mother is née Huang 黃氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Zheng Dayong 大用 and Zheng Kezai 克載 [Instructor], his younger brothers are Zheng Dezheng 德正 and Zheng Kechang 克昌, and he married née Chen 陳氏. He placed 46th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 129th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Xu Zhiwen 徐志文: Registered in a military household in Xinchang County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, he was a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing). His style name was Dahua, he was first in seniority among his brothers, and he was thirty-one sui, born on the tenth day of the fifth month. His great-grandfather was Xu Shouzhong, his grandfather was Xu Yiduan, his father was Xu Jingzhao, and his mother was née Hu. Both his parents and grandparents were living. His younger brothers were Zhiyi, Zhixian, Zhigong, Zhijin, and Zhifan. He married a woman née Shi, and took a second wife, also née Shi. He placed eighty-seventh in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and two hundred and first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Ying 陳英: Registered in a civilian household in Xingan County, Linjiang Prefecture, Jiangxi, he was a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing). His style name was Chaoyan, he was first in seniority among his brothers, and he was thirty-two sui, born on the fourth day of the twelfth month. His great-grandfather was Chen Wenxin, his grandfather was Chen Shiwang, his father was Chen Mengshi, and his mother was née Ruan. Both his parents and grandparents were living. His younger brother was Shan. He married a woman née Liu. He placed fifty-seventh in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred and seventy-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Guo Jijing 郭緝經: Registered in a military household in Luling County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi, he was a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing). His style name was Lüchang, he was fourth in seniority among his brothers, and he was thirty-seven sui, born on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month. His great-grandfather was Guo Tianxiang, his grandfather was Guo Zhongyong, his father was Guo Congyi, and his mother was née Peng. Both his parents were living. His elder brothers were Jixi, Jijing, and Jizhi; his younger brother was Jining. He married a woman née Ling. He placed one hundred and twenty-third in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred and third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fan Gui 樊貴: Registered in a civilian household in Jinyun County, Chuzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang, he was a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing). His style name was Yongde, he was sixteenth in seniority in his generation, and he was thirty-four sui, born on the ninth day of the fourth month. His great-grandfather was Fan Gui, his grandfather was Fan Jing (Administration Vice Commissioner of Jiangxi), his father was Fan Jun, and his mother was née Li. His mother was living (his father having died). His elder brothers were Song and Kai; his younger brothers were Zi and Xiang. He married a woman née Zheng. He placed fifteenth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred and sixty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

官榮〔貫福建沙縣人，錦衣衛軍匠籍，國子生，治《書經》，字志仁，行三，年三十二，八月二十九日生〕。曾祖巽，祖文鳳，父祝，母易氏，繼母宋氏。具慶下。兄政、祖，弟濬。娶沈氏。順天府鄉試第十三名，會試第一百六十五名。

translation_en:
Zhang Qi 張玘 [originally from Wu County in the Metropolitan Area (Zhili), a supernumerary soldier in the Embroidered-uniform Guard; specialized in the Book of Documents (Shujing); style name Tingyu; first in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-seventh day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Yanzhen, his grandfather was Yixu, his father is Dechong, his mother was Madam Fang, and his stepmother is Madam Tong. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Jin and Huan, and he is married to Madam Li. He placed 59th in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination and 91st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Bin 周賓 [registered as a commoner in Anfu County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; an added student of the Prefectural School; specialized in the Book of Changes (Yijing); style name Guanguang; fourth in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the twenty-fifth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Qiqian, his grandfather was Zhixiao, his father was Jiamian [posthumously granted the title of Supervising Secretary of the Office of Scrutiny for Rites], and his mother was Madam Peng [invested as Child Nurturess]. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Jian [former Supervising Secretary of the Office of Scrutiny for Rites], Yong, and Ang, and he is married to Madam Liu. He placed 163rd in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 138th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Guan Rong 官榮 [originally from Sha County, Fujian, registered as a military artisan in the Embroidered-uniform Guard; a Directorate Student; specialized in the Book of Documents (Shujing); style name Zhiren; third in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the twenty-ninth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Xun, his grandfather was Wenfeng, his father is Zhu, his mother was Madam Yi, and his stepmother is Madam Song. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Zheng and Zu, his younger brother is Jun, and he is married to Madam Shen. He placed 13th in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination and 165th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Shibao 陳仕寶 [registered as a commoner in Jieyang County, Chaozhou Prefecture, Guangdong; an added student of the Prefectural School; specialized in the Book of Documents (Shujing); style name Jingxian; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty, born on the fourteenth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Lao, his grandfather was Zhen, his father is Ji, and his mother is Madam Lin. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Shifu, Shiguang, and Shishen, and he is married to Madam Xu. He placed 58th in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and 194th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Jiang Liang 姜諒 (registered as a civilian household in Jiaxing County 嘉興縣, Jiaxing Prefecture 嘉興府, Zhejiang 浙江; a Student of the Directorate of Education [guozisheng] specializing in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Yongzhen 用貞, third in seniority, aged twenty-six, born on the twenty-seventh day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Mingzhi 明之, his grandfather was Jingwen 景文, his father was Di 迪, and his mother is née Wenren 聞人. His mother is living and his father is deceased (cishixia). His elder brothers are Xingzong 興宗, Rang 讓, and E 諤, and he is married to née Shen 沈. He placed sixteenth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and two hundred twenty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhu Qing 朱清 (registered as a civilian household in Jining Subprefecture 濟寧州, Yanzhou Prefecture 兖州府, Shandong 山東; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Xizhi 熈之, third in seniority, aged thirty-five, born on the twenty-seventh day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Xian 顯, his grandfather was Yu 玉, his father was Wenying 文英, and his mother is née Yao 姚. His mother is living and his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Zhen 真 and Yuan 源, and he is married to née Shao 邵. He placed eighty-second in the Shandong Provincial Examination and one hundred fourteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Cong 王琮 (a native of Longquan County 龍泉縣, Zhejiang 浙江, registered in a military household of the Right Guard of the Imperial Insignia [Jinwu Youwei 金吾右衛]; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Wenyu 文玉, first in seniority, aged thirty-four, born on the nineteenth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Yunzhong 允中, his grandfather was Rongqing 榮清, his father is Jing 敬, and his mother is née Wei 韋. Both of his parents are living (juqingxia). His younger brother is Heng 珩, and he is married to née Yang 楊. He placed one hundred thirteenth in the Shuntian Prefectural [Provincial] Examination and seventy-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen An 陳按 (registered as a civilian household in Putian County 莆田縣, Xinghua Prefecture 興化府, Fujian 福建; a Prefectural Student [fuxuesheng] specializing in the Classic of History; courtesy name Chaoju 朝舉, first in seniority, aged thirty-four, born on the thirteenth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Ningzong 寧宗, his grandfather was Dechang 德昌, his father is Tingxin 廷欣, and his mother was née Xu 許. His father is living and his mother is deceased (yanshixia). His younger brothers are Jing 敬, Hui 撝, Gong 拱, Kuo 擴, Huan 瓛, and Ju 據; he married née Zhang 張 and took as his second wife née [?]. He placed seventy-seventh in the Fujian Provincial Examination and two hundred twenty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.
