His great-grandfather was Cunyi 存彝; his grandfather was Liang 亮; his father is Lin 霖, and his mother is née Zhong 鍾氏. Both parents are living. His younger brother is Jie 詰. He married née Fei 費氏. He placed eighty-sixth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and fifty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yan Zuo 閻佐 [registered in an artisan household in Shang County 商縣, Xi'an Prefecture 西安府, Shaanxi 陝西; National University Student; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Wenfu 文輔; first in seniority among brothers; age thirty-three, born on the second day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Liang 亮; his grandfather was Quan 銓; his father is Ying 英, and his mother is née Zhang 張氏. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Biao 彪, Zhong 忠, and Ming 銘. He married née Song 宋氏. He placed tenth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Weng Xin 翁信 [a native of Yuyao County 餘姚縣, Zhejiang 浙江, registered in a military household in the Embroidered-Uniform Guard; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Chengzhi 誠之; first in seniority among brothers; age thirty-two, born on the twenty-seventh day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Jian 堅; his grandfather was Yongfu 永福; his father is Qi 玘, and his mother is née Wu 吳氏. Both parents are living. He married née Lin 林氏. He placed one hundred eighty-seventh in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and sixty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Dai Yu 戴玉 [registered in an artisan household in Wanping County 宛平縣, Shuntian Prefecture 順天府; National University Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Derun 德潤; first in seniority among brothers; age thirty-two, born on the sixteenth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Shan 善; his grandfather was Chuiyu 垂裕; his father is Tong 通, and his mother is née Gu 顧氏. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Jue 玨 and Xuan [?] 𤪌. He married née Bao 鮑氏. He placed second in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Shan Mao 陝茂 [registered in Gong'an County, Jingzhou Prefecture, Huguang, under civilian household status; a County Confucians School student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Benshen, second in seniority among brothers, age twenty-eight, born on the twenty-eighth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Shan Jingxian; his grandfather was Shan Yuandao; his father is Shan Tinglan, and his mother is née Huang. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Benhong, and his younger brother is Maobin. He married née Yang. He placed fiftieth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and one hundred fifty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Xuan 沈瑄 [registered in Changshu County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), under civilian household status; a County Confucian School student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Tingbi, first in seniority among brothers, age twenty-six, born on the twenty-third day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Shen Boliang; his grandfather is Shen Gong; his father is Shen Kui, and his mother is née Ma. Both of his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Guan, Fan, Yu, and Jin. He married née Zhu. He placed one hundred thirty-third in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and two hundred second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yao Jun 姚俊 [registered in Xiushui County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, under civilian household status; a National University student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Yongzhang, second in seniority among brothers, age thirty-six, born on the twenty-first day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Yao Borang; his grandfather was Yao Zhongqian; his father is Yao Ji, and his mother is née Tang. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Xu, and his younger brothers are Jie and Bian. He married née Zhou, and subsequently married née Wang. He placed sixtieth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred seventy-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Xishao 劉熈劭 [registered in Shishou County, Jingzhou Prefecture, Huguang, under civilian household status; a National University student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Kexuan, second in seniority among brothers, age thirty-four, born on the fourteenth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Liu Shoufu [posthumously honored as Senior Compiler of the Hanlin Academy]; his grandfather is Liu Yongqing [Right Administration Commissioner of Guangdong]; his father is Liu Donggeng, and his mother is née Wu. Both of his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Ximai and Xichi. He married née Tian. He placed sixty-fourth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and one hundred seventy-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

汪杲〔貫直隸徽州府休寧縣軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字廷輝，行二，年四十五，八月十九日生〕。曾祖德甫，祖志賢，父景濱，母馮氏。永感下。兄梁，弟榮〔貢士〕、楘、棐、槩、稟。娶張氏。應天府鄉試第九十七名，會試第一百七十四名。

translation_en:
Shen An 申安 (registered in a civilian household of Xiangfu County 祥符縣, Kaifeng Prefecture 開封府, Henan 河南; Added Student of the County School; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zhongshu 仲舒; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the twenty-third day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Daozhong 道中, his grandfather was Yi 義, his father was Haoxue 好學, his father's former wife was Madam Zhen 甄氏, and his mother is Madam Yang 揚氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Kuan 寛 and Li 禮, and his younger brother is Ning 寧. He married Madam Chen 陳氏. He placed fifteenth in the Henan Provincial Examination and two hundred twenty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Du Mao 杜懋 (registered in a military household of Yanling County 鄢陵縣, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan; Directorate Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Damian 大勉; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the seventh day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Chengfu 成甫, his grandfather was Gui 圭, his father is Rong 榮, and his mother is Madam Hao 郝氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Jian 鑑, Kuan 寛, and Xin 信. He married Madam Niu 牛氏. He placed thirty-fifth in the Henan Provincial Examination and eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Gao 汪杲 (registered in a military household of Xiuning County 休寧縣, Huizhou Prefecture 徽州府, Zhili 直隸; Directorate Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Tinghui 廷輝; second in seniority among his brothers; aged forty-five, born on the nineteenth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Defu 德甫, his grandfather was Zhixian 志賢, his father was Jingbin 景濱, and his mother was Madam Feng 馮氏. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brother is Liang 梁, and his younger brothers are Rong 榮 (Tribute Student [gongshi]), Mu 楘, Fei 棐, Gai 槩, and Bing 稟. He married Madam Zhang 張氏. He placed ninety-seventh in the Yingtian Prefectural 應天府 Provincial Examination and one hundred seventy-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Tai 張泰 (a native of Wujin County 武進縣, Zhili, registered in a military household of the Taicang Guard 太倉衛; Military Student of the Guard School; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Hengfu 亨父; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the sixth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Yuanrui 原瑞, his grandfather was Xingzong 興宗, his father is Zhong 忠, and his mother is Madam Xu 徐氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are An 安, Ning 寧, and Kang 康. He married Madam Guan 管氏, and was subsequently betrothed to Madam Wu 武氏. He placed third in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred fifty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Dong Lun 董綸 [registered in a civilian household of Shanghai County, Songjiang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Chengzhi; second in generational order; age thirty-seven, born on the fourth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Zhongzhuang; his grandfather was Sizhong; his father was Yihe, and his mother was née Jiang. His mother is living (father deceased). His elder brother is Jing, and his younger brother is Chun. He married a woman née Xie. He placed 96th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 20th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tang Zhen 唐震 [registered in a military household of Liling County, Changsha Prefecture, Huguang; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Kongheng; second in generational order; age forty-one, born on the fifth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Guoxiang; his grandfather was Boxun; his father was Shihui, and his mother was née Li. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brother is Liang [Instructor], and his younger brother is Ding [Tribute Student (gongshi)]. He married a woman née Ding, and remarried a woman née He. He placed 2nd in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 22nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Dao 陳道 [registered in a military household of Xuyi County, Fengyang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); County Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Dexiu; fourth in generational order; age twenty-nine, born on the twenty-sixth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Yiren; his grandfather was Tianfu; his father was Rong, his father's former wife was née Liu, his mother was née Xie, and his stepmother is née Sun. His stepmother is living (father and birth mother deceased). His elder brothers are Duan [Instructor], Jie, and Jing, and his younger brother is Da. He married a woman née Wang. He placed 132nd in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 53rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Chen 王臣 [registered in a military household of Pucheng County, Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; County Student; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Shangzhong; fourth in generational order; age thirty-five, born on the fourth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Fuli; his grandfather was Zhongsu; his father is Wei, his mother was née Li, and his stepmother is née Han. Both his father and stepmother are living. His elder brothers are Lao [𦒎], Zhi, and Qi. He married a woman née Sun. He placed 27th in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 244th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Zhang Wenyao 張文曜 [registered under civilian household status in Xiangshan County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang; a county student; specialized in the Book of Changes (Yijing); style name Huiji; fifty-third in generational seniority; aged thirty [?], born on the eighth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Zhongren, his grandfather was Zhang Botong, his father is Zhang Jingqian, and his mother was née Yao. His father is living. His elder brothers are Zhang Wenshu, Zhang Wenye, Zhang Wenyang, Zhang Wentong, Zhang Wenjun, Zhang Wenying, Zhang Wenshi, and Zhang Wendan. He is betrothed to a woman née Shi. He placed fifteenth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 163rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiao Ding 蕭鼎 [registered under civilian household status in Haiyang County, Chaozhou Prefecture, Guangdong; a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Book of Documents (Shujing); style name Boxuan; first in generational seniority; aged forty, born on the twenty-eighth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Xiao Ming, his grandfather was Xiao Miao, his father was Xiao Yong, and his mother is née Xu. His mother is living. His younger brothers are Xiao Nai, Xiao Zi, Xiao Xun, Xiao Tao, Xiao Wei, Xiao Jiong, Xiao Zhuo, and Xiao Ye. He married a woman née Zhou, and remarried to a woman née Huang. He placed seventy-seventh in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and 189th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tao Xi 陶璽 [registered under military household status in Jiang Department, Pingyang Prefecture, Shanxi; a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Book of Documents (Shujing); style name Tingyong; fourth in generational seniority; aged thirty-two, born on the seventeenth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Tao Boqing, his grandfather was Tao Chun [posthumously honored as Vice Director], his father is Tao Quan [Vice Director in the Ministry of Rites], and his mother is née Li [invested as Lady of Suitability]. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Tao Gui, Tao Zan, and Tao Cong, and his younger brother is Tao Yan. He married a woman née Zhao. He placed twenty-first in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 131st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Zongda 李宗達 [registered under military household status in Min County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian; a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Book of Odes (Shijing); style name Shiwang; second in generational seniority; aged thirty-four, born on the fifteenth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Tingjin, his grandfather was Li Ge, his father is Li Boda, and his mother is née Lin. Both his parents are living. His younger brothers are Li Zongwei and Li Zongyang. He married a woman née Liu, and remarried to a woman née Lin. He placed eighty-seventh in the Fujian Provincial Examination and thirty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
劉珙：貫直隸永平府撫寧縣，民籍，府學生。治《詩經》，字廷獻，行一，年二十五，六月初八日生。曾祖源，祖本〔知府〕，父鉞〔吏部郎中〕，母單氏〔贈宜人〕，繼母馮氏〔封宜人〕。具慶下，弟玫、璔，娶張氏。順天府鄉試第三十四名，會試第九十八名。

傅允：貫河南開封府儀封縣，民籍，國子生。治《詩經》，字克誠，行六，年三十一，十一月初四日生。曾祖貴，祖守信，父廷美，母魯氏。慈侍下，兄寬、宏、實、政、瑩，弟徵，娶郭氏。河南鄉試第四十九名，會試第二百一十七名。

王詔：貫直隸真定府趙州寧晉縣，民籍，國子生。治《禮記》，字文振，行二，年三十七，五月初五日生。曾祖思義，祖理〔絳州判官〕，父昂，母張氏，繼母畢氏。具慶下，兄銘〔序班〕、謙，弟讓、誥、鏖，娶曹氏。順天府鄉試第五十五名，會試第八十五名。

劉仁：貫四川重慶府合州，民籍，國子生。治《易經》，字元善，行一，年三十六，十一月初八日生。曾祖志善，祖永堅，父根〔隂陽訓術〕，母李氏。具慶下，弟儀、伋、健、佐、信、倜，娶彭氏，繼娶張氏。四川鄉試第七十一名，會試第一百十八名。
translation_en:
Liu Gong 劉珙 (courtesy name Tingxian 廷獻, seniority first) was registered as a civilian household in Funing County 撫寧縣, Yongping Prefecture 永平府, in the Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸), and was a Prefectural Student (fuxuesheng 府學生) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing). He was twenty-five sui, born on the eighth day of the sixth month. His great-grandfather was Liu Yuan 源; his grandfather was Liu Ben 本 (Prefect, zhifu); his father was Liu Yue 鉞 (Director in the Ministry of Personnel, Libu langzhong); his mother was née Shan 單氏 (posthumously conferred the title of Lady of Suitability, yiren); and his stepmother was née Feng 馮氏 (conferred the title of Lady of Suitability). Both parents were living; his younger brothers were Mei 玫 and Zeng 璔, and he married née Zhang 張氏. He placed thirty-fourth in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and ninety-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fu Yun 傅允 (courtesy name Kecheng 克誠, seniority sixth) was registered as a civilian household in Yifeng County 儀封縣, Kaifeng Prefecture 開封府, Henan 河南, and was a National University Student (guozisheng 國子生) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing). He was thirty-one sui, born on the fourth day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Fu Gui 貴; his grandfather was Fu Shouxin 守信; his father was Fu Tingmei 廷美; and his mother was née Lu 魯氏. His mother was living; his elder brothers were Kuan 寬, Hong 宏, Shi 實, Zheng 政, and Ying 瑩, his younger brother was Zheng 徵, and he married née Guo 郭氏. He placed forty-ninth in the Henan Provincial Examination and two hundred seventeenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Zhao 王詔 (courtesy name Wenzhen 文振, seniority second) was registered as a civilian household in Ningjin County 寧晉縣, Zhao Subprefecture 趙州, Zhending Prefecture 真定府, in the Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸), and was a National University Student (guozisheng 國子生) specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji). He was thirty-seven sui, born on the fifth day of the fifth month. His great-grandfather was Wang Siyi 思義; his grandfather was Wang Li 理 (Assistant Subprefectural Magistrate of Jiang Subprefecture, Jiangzhou panguan 絳州判官); his father was Wang Ang 昂; his mother was née Zhang 張氏; and his stepmother was née Bi 畢氏. Both parents were living; his elder brothers were Ming 銘 (Usher, xuban) and Qian 謙, his younger brothers were Rang 讓, Gao 誥, and Ao 鏖, and he married née Cao 曹氏. He placed fifty-fifth in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and eighty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Ren 劉仁 (courtesy name Yuanshan 元善, seniority first) was registered as a civilian household in He Subprefecture 合州, Chongqing Prefecture 重慶府, Sichuan 四川, and was a National University Student (guozisheng 國子生) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing). He was thirty-six sui, born on the eighth day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Liu Zhishan 志善; his grandfather was Liu Yongjian 永堅; his father was Liu Gen 根 (County Instructor of Divination, yinyang xunshu); and his mother was née Li 李氏. Both parents were living; his younger brothers were Yi 儀, Ji 伋, Jian 健, Zuo 佐, Xin 信, and Ti 倜, and he married née Peng 彭氏 and subsequently married née Zhang 張氏. He placed seventy-first in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and one hundred eighteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
陳達〔貫山東青州府莒州日照縣，軍籍，國子生。治《易經》，字兼善，行一，年三十六，四月十二日生〕。曾祖四翁，祖彥名，父文〔聽選官〕，母陳氏。具慶下，娶黃氏。山東鄉試第四十八名，會試第五十八名。

劉道〔貫山西大同府懷仁縣，軍籍，國子生。治《詩經》，字從理，行二，年二十九，十月十二日生〕。曾祖文義，祖清〔鴻臚寺丞〕，父晟〔己未進士〕，母王氏。具慶下，兄遜，弟迪、端，娶韓氏。山西鄉試第一名，會試第十八名。

夏景〔貫江西新喻縣人，順天府大興縣匠籍，國子生。治《書經》，字時中，行一，年三十三，十二月二十九日生〕。曾祖務信，祖立奇，父東啓，母王氏，繼母金氏。嚴侍下，弟昱、旻、昪、昇、暠，娶沈氏。順天府鄉試第二百三十八名，會試第一百五十七名。

陳賓〔貫直隸常州府無錫縣，民籍，縣學生。治《詩經》，字朝用，行三，年三十五，八月二十日生〕。曾祖季義，祖興祖，父立名〔知縣〕，母張氏。具慶下，兄資、質，弟贊，娶談氏，繼娶吳氏。應天府鄉試第十七名，會試第十三名。
translation_en:
Chen Da 陳達, courtesy name Jianshan 兼善, the first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-six, born on the twelfth day of the fourth month, was registered in a military household in Rizhao County, Ju Subprefecture, Qingzhou Prefecture, Shandong, and served as a National University Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing). His great-grandfather was Chen Siweng 四翁; his grandfather was Chen Yanming 彥名; his father was Chen Wen 文, an Official Awaiting Appointment (tingxuan guan); and his mother was née Chen 陳. Both of his parents were living; he married née Huang 黃. He placed forty-eighth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and fifty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Dao 劉道, courtesy name Congli 從理, the second in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-nine, born on the twelfth day of the tenth month, was registered in a military household in Huairen County, Datong Prefecture, Shanxi, and served as a National University Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing). His great-grandfather was Liu Wenyi 文義; his grandfather was Liu Qing 清, an Assistant Minister of the Court of State Ceremonial (Honglusi cheng); his father was Liu Sheng 晟, a metropolitan graduate (jinshi) of the jiwei year (1439); and his mother was née Wang 王. Both of his parents were living; his elder brother was Liu Xun 遜, his younger brothers were Liu Di 迪 and Liu Duan 端, and he married née Han 韓. He placed first in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and eighteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xia Jing 夏景, courtesy name Shizhong 時中, the first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-three, born on the twenty-ninth day of the twelfth month, was originally from Xinyu County, Jiangxi, registered in an artisan household in Daxing County, Shuntian Prefecture, and served as a National University Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing). His great-grandfather was Xia Wuxin 務信; his grandfather was Xia Liqi 立奇; his father was Xia Dongqi 東啓; his mother was née Wang 王; and his stepmother was née Jin 金. His father was living; his younger brothers were Xia Yu 昱, Xia Min 旻, Xia Bian 昪, Xia Sheng 昇, and Xia Gao 暠, and he married née Shen 沈. He placed two hundred thirty-eighth in the Shuntian Provincial Examination and one hundred fifty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Bin 陳賓, courtesy name Chaoyong 朝用, the third in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-five, born on the twentieth day of the eighth month, was registered in a commoner household in Wuxi County, Changzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), and served as a County School Student (xianxuesheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing). His great-grandfather was Chen Jiyi 季義; his grandfather was Chen Xingzu 興祖; his father was Chen Liming 立名, a District Magistrate (zhixian); and his mother was née Zhang 張. Both of his parents were living; his elder brothers were Chen Zi 資 and Chen Zhi 質, his younger brother was Chen Zan 贊, and he married née Tan 談 and remarried née Wu 吳. He placed seventeenth in the Yingtian Provincial Examination and thirteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

His courtesy name was Mengchuan, he was the first in his generational line, and he was forty-four years old, born on the twenty-seventh day of the fourth month. His great-grandfather was Zheng Hongyi, his grandfather was Zheng Shanji, his father was Zheng Liangbo, and his mother was née Liu. His mother was living and his father deceased. He was married to née Huang. He placed 56th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 76th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Cheng 黃澄, registered in a civilian household in Fengyang County, Fengyang Prefecture, in the Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), was a Directorate Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu). His courtesy name was Jingzhi, he was the first in his generational line, and he was twenty-nine years old, born on the eighteenth day of the fourth month. His great-grandfather was Huang Maoxiang, his grandfather was Huang Gui (who held the honorary title of Longevity Official, shouguan), his father was Huang Shen, his mother was née Sun, and his stepmother was née Lu. Both his parents and grandparents were living. His younger brothers were Huang Ji, Huang Hong, Huang Lan, Huang Hai, Huang Qing, and Huang Zhou, and he was married to née Shi. He placed 123rd in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 243rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Pang Xuan 龐瑄 (registered in Qi County, Taiyuan Prefecture, Shanxi, under military household registration; a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Documents; courtesy name Tingyu, first in seniority among his brothers, aged forty-two, born on the seventh day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Pang Xinfu; his grandfather was Pang Qian (Subprefectural Instructor); his father is Pang Congyun (Prefectural Instructor); and his mother is née Bai. Both parents are living; he married née Wu. He ranked 100th in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 235th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wei Rong 魏容 (registered in Anding County, Gongchang Prefecture, Shaanxi, under military household registration; a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Documents; courtesy name Zunyi, seventh in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-eight, born on the twenty-first day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Wei Dehou (Brigade Commander in the Yuan dynasty); his grandfather was Wei Ji (Battalion Commander); his father was Wei Duan (Prefectural Registrar); and his mother was née Zhang. Both parents are deceased; his elder brothers are Wei Qian, Wei Jin, Wei Fu, Wei Chun, Wei Ping, and Wei Gui; he married née Qu. He ranked 17th in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 14th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Dai Shan 戴珊 (registered in Fuliang County, Raozhou Prefecture, Jiangxi, under civilian household registration; a County Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Tingzhen, eighteenth in seniority among his male cousins, aged twenty-eight, born on the seventh day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Dai Zhongcai; his grandfather was Dai Si'an (posthumously honoured as District Magistrate); his father is Dai Shiyi (Instructor of the Prefectural Confucian School); and his mother is née Wu. Both parents are living; his elder brothers are Dai Hun, Dai Can (Vice Prefect), and Dai Lu, and his younger brothers are Dai Tang, Dai Wu, and Dai Yu; he married née Hou. He ranked 23rd in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 145th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Hong 陳宏 (registered in Longxi County, Zhangzhou Prefecture, Fujian, under military household registration; a Directorate Student specializing in the Record of Rites; courtesy name Pidao, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-five, born on the sixth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Chen Runing; his grandfather was Chen Deliang; his father was Chen Zhimin; and his mother is née Zhou. His mother is living (his father is deceased); his younger brother is Chen Chong; he married née Tu. He ranked 61st in the Fujian Provincial Examination and [illegible] in the Metropolitan Examination.

戴賓〔貫湖廣荊州府江陵縣軍籍，縣學生，治《書經》，字邦彥，行三，年三十一，六月二十一日生〕。曾祖文旺；祖添壽；父興榮；母易氏。慈侍下。兄思賢、思讓；弟思誠、思傑。娶李氏。湖廣鄉試第三十名，會試第一百三十六名。
translation_en:
Yang Zhen 楊振: Registered in a civilian household of Gaoping County 高平縣, Zezhou 澤州, Shanxi 山西; a Student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Ting-□ [illegible]; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the twenty-eighth day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Yang Sigong 楊思恭; his grandfather was Yang Yu 楊郁; his father was Yang Sheng 楊昇; his mother was née Kong 孔氏. Both parents are deceased. His younger brothers are Yang Lu 楊祿, Yang Xi 楊禧, and Yang Fu 楊撫. He married née Chang 常氏, and remarried née Li 李氏. He ranked twenty-fifth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 167th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Botong 吳伯通: Registered in a civilian household of Guang'an Subprefecture 廣安州, Shunqing Prefecture 順慶府, Sichuan 四川; an Added Student (zengguangsheng) of the Subprefectural School specializing in the Classic of Changes; courtesy name Yuanming 原明; first in seniority; aged twenty-four, born on the third day of the fourth month. His great-grandfather was Wu Hai 吳海; his grandfather was Wu Youneng 吳友能; his father is Wu Fu 吳輔; his mother is née Xin 辛氏. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Wu Boliang 吳伯良, and his younger brother is Wu Bochun 吳伯淳. He married née Ou 歐氏. He ranked third in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and fifteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jin Zhong 金忠: A native of Lishui County 麗水縣, Chuzhou Prefecture 處州府, Zhejiang 浙江, registered in a civilian household of Yunhe County 雲和縣; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Changes; courtesy name Shangyi 尚義; second in seniority; aged thirty-three, born on the seventeenth day of the seventh month. His great-grandfather was Jin Shan 金善 (Subprefectural Magistrate of Bazhou 霸州); his grandfather was Jin Shudu 金叔度 (posthumously honoured as Investigating Censor); his father is Jin Kai 金愷 (Assistant Surveillance Commissioner of Yunnan 雲南); his mother is née Gao 高氏 (invested as Lady of Suitability). Both parents are living. His elder brother is Jin Wen 金文 (Vice Director in the Ministry of Justice), and his younger brothers are Jin Xin 金信 and Jin Zhao 金詔. He married née Zhou 周氏. He ranked fifty-seventh in the Yingtian Prefectural 應天府 Provincial Examination and eighty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Dai Bin 戴賓: Registered in a military household of Jiangling County 江陵縣, Jingzhou Prefecture 荊州府, Huguang 湖廣; a County School Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Bangyan 邦彥; third in seniority; aged thirty-one, born on the twenty-first day of the sixth month. His great-grandfather was Dai Wenwang 戴文旺; his grandfather was Dai Tianshou 戴添壽; his father was Dai Xingrong 戴興榮; his mother is née Yi 易氏. His father is deceased and his mother is living. His elder brothers are Dai Sixian 戴思賢 and Dai Sirang 戴思讓, and his younger brothers are Dai Sicheng 戴思誠 and Dai Sijie 戴思傑. He married née Li 李氏. He ranked thirtieth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 136th in the Metropolitan Examination.

劉鈍〔貫江西吉安府廬陵縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字望儒，行二，年四十二，正月初六日生〕。曾祖以遜，祖仲戬，父大經，母吳氏，繼母羅氏。具慶下，兄釗，弟鉞、鏘、鎖、鎮，娶周氏，繼娶周氏。江西鄉試第二十一名，會試第一百七十一名。
馮貫〔貫直隸保定府蠡縣軍籍，國子生，治《書經》，字大用，行三，年三十二，閏八月十八日生〕。曾祖守道〔元御史〕，祖彥舉〔主簿〕，父吉，母朱氏。具慶下，兄懽、悅，娶李氏。順天府鄉試第一百九十一名，會試第九十九名。
李芳〔貫湖廣荊州府公安縣軍籍，國子生，治《書經》，字時芳，行一，年三十六，五月十九日生〕。曾祖彥誠，祖友仁，父翬，母王氏。具慶下，弟茂、蕚、蘄、蓉、英、蘭、芫、蘧、莘，娶鄧氏。湖廣鄉試第六名，會試第一百九名。
薛綱〔貫浙江紹興府山陰縣民籍，縣學生，治《詩經》，字之綱，行一，年三十七，八月二十九日生〕。曾祖智，祖倫，父宗彝，母李氏。具慶下，弟紀、網、維、經、紘、績、縉，娶陳氏。浙江鄉試第十四名，會試第一百五十八名。
translation_en:
Liu Dun 劉鈍 (registered as a civilian household in Luling County 廬陵縣, Ji'an Prefecture 吉安府, Jiangxi 江西; National University Student (guozisheng); specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Wangru 望儒; second in seniority among brothers; aged forty-two, born on the sixth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Liu Yixun 以遜; his grandfather was Liu Zhongjian 仲戬; his father is Liu Dajing 大經; his mother was née Wu 吳, and his stepmother is née Luo 羅. Both parents (father and stepmother) are living; his elder brother is Liu Zhao 釗, and his younger brothers are Liu Yue 鉞, Liu Qiang 鏘, Liu Suo 鎖, and Liu Zhen 鎮; he married née Zhou 周, and remarried née Zhou 周. He placed twenty-first in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred seventy-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Feng Guan 馮貫 (registered as a military household in Li County 蠡縣, Baoding Prefecture 保定府, Zhili 直隸; National University Student (guozisheng); specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Dayong 大用; third in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the eighteenth day of the intercalary eighth month). His great-grandfather was Feng Shoudao 守道 (Censor in the Yuan dynasty); his grandfather was Feng Yanju 彥舉 (Assistant Magistrate); his father is Feng Ji 吉; and his mother is née Zhu 朱. Both parents are living; his elder brothers are Feng Huan 懽 and Feng Yue 悅; and he married née Li 李. He placed one hundred ninety-first in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and ninety-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Fang 李芳 (registered as a military household in Gong'an County 公安縣, Jingzhou Prefecture 荊州府, Huguang 湖廣; National University Student (guozisheng); specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Shifang 時芳; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-six, born on the nineteenth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Li Yancheng 彥誠; his grandfather was Li Youren 友仁; his father is Li Hui 翬; and his mother is née Wang 王. Both parents are living; his younger brothers are Li Mao 茂, Li E 蕚, Li Qi 蘄, Li Rong 蓉, Li Ying 英, Li Lan 蘭, Li Yuan 芫, Li Qu 蘧, and Li Shen 莘; and he married née Deng 鄧. He placed sixth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and one hundred ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xue Gang 薛綱 (registered as a civilian household in Shanyin County 山陰縣, Shaoxing Prefecture 紹興府, Zhejiang 浙江; County School Student (xianxuesheng); specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zhigang 之綱; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-seven, born on the twenty-ninth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Xue Zhi 智; his grandfather was Xue Lun 倫; his father is Xue Zongyi 宗彝; and his mother is née Li 李. Both parents are living; his younger brothers are Xue Ji 紀, Xue Wang 網, Xue Wei 維, Xue Jing 經, Xue Hong 紘, Xue Ji 績, and Xue Jin 縉; and he married née Chen 陳. He placed fourteenth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred fifty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

呂昇〔貫湖廣襄陽縣人，舍人，治《易經》，字明遠，行一，年三十二，正月二十五日生〕。曾祖敬文〔贈指揮僉事〕，祖義〔贈指揮僉事〕，父貴〔指揮僉事〕，嫡母王氏〔贈恭人〕，生母李氏，繼母榮氏。具慶下，弟昴、杲、昪，娶楊氏。順天府鄉試第三十名，會試第二十六名。
translation_en:
[…] […]-qing □□卿 (registered in a military household of Tongliang County, Chongqing Prefecture, Sichuan; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Tingjue; third in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-three, born on the twenty-eighth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Fachang, his grandfather was Youbin, his father is Biguang (former Case Reviewer in the Court of Judicial Review), and his mother is née Ai (invested as Child Nurturer). Both of his parents are living; his elder brothers are Fu (Assistant Surveillance Commissioner of Yunnan) and Bi, his younger brothers are Kuang, Zuo, and Jie, and he is married to née Qin. He placed nineteenth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and one hundred fifty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Mao Yi 毛鸃 (registered in a civilian household of Changyuan County, Daming Prefecture, Directly Attached region [Zhili]; a County Student specializing in the Classic of Changes; courtesy name Tingrui; first in seniority; aged twenty-nine, born on the twenty-eighth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Jingzhong, his grandfather was Hong, his father is Xin, and his mother is née Yang. Both of his parents are living; his elder brother is E (Assistant County Magistrate), his younger brothers are Peng, Yuan, Yuan, An, Jiu, and Ying, and he is married to née Zhang. He placed seventy-first in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination and thirty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Chun 劉淳 (registered in a military household of Ba County, Chongqing Prefecture, Sichuan; a Translator in the Hanlin Academy specializing in the Classic of Changes; courtesy name Shangzhi; first in seniority; aged thirty, born on the twenty-fourth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Pushou, his grandfather was Puliang, his father was Shiyi, and his mother is née Su. His mother is living; his younger brother is Pu, and he is married to née Feng. He placed fifty-fifth in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination and two hundred thirtieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lü Sheng 呂昇 (a native of Xiangyang County, Huguang; a Houseman specializing in the Classic of Changes; courtesy name Mingyuan; first in seniority; aged thirty-two, born on the twenty-fifth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Jingwen (posthumously honoured as Assistant Guard Commander), his grandfather was Yi (posthumously honoured as Assistant Guard Commander), his father is Gui (Assistant Guard Commander), his legal mother was née Wang (posthumously honoured as Revered Person), his birth mother is née Li, and his stepmother is née Rong. Both of his parents are living; his younger brothers are Mao, Gao, and Bian, and he is married to née Yang. He placed thirtieth in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination and twenty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

具慶下　兄廷資　弟廷言　廷立　娶雷氏

貫福建漳州府龍溪縣軍籍　縣學增廣生

慈侍下　兄璣　弟球　娶陳氏
福建鄉試第六十名　會試第一百八十二名
===
康玠
貫江西吉安府泰和縣民籍　縣學增廣生
治書經字廷圭行六年三十八二月初五日生
曾祖漢復　祖士廉　父允昇　母羅氏
具慶下　兄璽　琢　弟瑛　珙　玘　琮　璟　娶宋氏
江西鄉試第七十七名　會試第一百一十九名
胡克勤
貫四川成都府仁壽縣軍籍　國子生
治書經字舜臣行一年三十五八月十八日生
曾祖友真　祖添祿　父應中　母郭氏
具慶下　弟克儉　克諧　娶李氏
四川鄉試第三十二名　會試第四十二名
punctuated:
袁球〔貫湖廣永州府道州寧遠縣，民籍，縣學生，治《書經》，字廷鳴，行二，年二十六，四月二十七日生〕。曾祖文善；祖宗善；父朝海，前母楊氏、李氏，母唐氏。具慶下。兄廷資，弟廷言、廷立。娶雷氏。湖廣鄉試第五十二名，會試第一百三十七名。

蕭璿〔貫福建漳州府龍溪縣，軍籍，縣學增廣生，治《易經》，字子璣，行二，年二十九，六月十六日生〕。曾祖順甫；祖添祿；父孟輝，母洪氏。慈侍下。兄瑀，弟球。娶陳氏。福建鄉試第十名，會試第一百八十名。

康珍〔貫江西吉安府泰和縣，民籍，縣學增廣生，治《書經》，字廷圭，行六，年三十八，二月初五日生〕。曾祖漢復；祖士廉；父允昇，母羅氏。具慶下。兄璽、琢，弟瑛、珙、玘、琮、琛。娶朱氏。江西鄉試第七十七名，會試第一百一十九名。

胡克勤〔貫四川成都府仁壽縣，軍籍，國子生，治《書經》，字舜臣，行一，年三十五，八月十八日生〕。曾祖友亮；祖添祿；父應中，母郭氏。具慶下。弟克儉、克諧。娶李氏。四川鄉試第五十三名，會試第四十八名。
translation_en:
Yuan Qiu 袁球 (courtesy name Tingming 廷鳴, second in his generation's birth order, aged twenty-six, born on the twenty-seventh day of the fourth month) was registered in a civilian household in Ningyuan County, Daozhou Department, Yongzhou Prefecture, Huguang, and was a County School Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing). His great-grandfather was Yuan Wenshan 文善, his grandfather was Yuan Zongshan 宗善, his father is Yuan Chaohai 朝海, his father's former wives were Lady Yang 楊氏 and Lady Li 李氏, and his mother is Lady Tang 唐氏. Both his parents are living; he has an elder brother, Tingzi 廷資, and younger brothers, Tingyan 廷言 and Tingli 廷立, and he is married to Lady Lei 雷氏. He placed fifty-second in the Huguang Provincial Examination and one hundred thirty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiao Xuan 蕭璿 (courtesy name Ziji 子璣, second in his generation's birth order, aged twenty-nine, born on the sixteenth day of the sixth month) was registered in a military household in Longxi County, Zhangzhou Prefecture, Fujian, and was an Added Student of the County School specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing). His great-grandfather was Xiao Shunfu 順甫, his grandfather was Xiao Tianlu 添祿, his father was Xiao Menghui 孟輝, and his mother is Lady Hong 洪氏. His mother is living; he has an elder brother, Yu 瑀, and a younger brother, Qiu 球, and he is married to Lady Chen 陳氏. He placed tenth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and one hundred eightieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Kang Zhen 康珍 (courtesy name Tinggui 廷圭, sixth in his generation's birth order, aged thirty-eight, born on the fifth day of the second month) was registered in a civilian household in Taihe County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi, and was an Added Student of the County School specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing). His great-grandfather was Kang Hanfu 漢復, his grandfather was Kang Shilian 士廉, his father is Kang Yunsheng 允昇, and his mother is Lady Luo 羅氏. Both his parents are living; he has elder brothers, Xi 璽 and Zhuo 琢, and younger brothers, Ying 瑛, Gong 珙, Qi 玘, Cong 琮, and Chen 琛, and he is married to Lady Zhu 朱氏. He placed seventy-seventh in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred nineteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Hu Keqin 胡克勤 (courtesy name Shunchen 舜臣, first in his generation's birth order, aged thirty-five, born on the eighteenth day of the eighth month) was registered in a military household in Renshou County, Chengdu Prefecture, Sichuan, and was a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing). His great-grandfather was Hu Youliang 友亮, his grandfather was Hu Tianlu 添祿, his father is Hu Yingzhong 應中, and his mother is Lady Guo 郭氏. Both his parents are living; he has younger brothers, Kejian 克儉 and Kexie 克諧, and he is married to Lady Li 李氏. He placed fifty-third in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and forty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
余諒〔貫廣東廣州府新會縣軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字以貞，行二，年二十六，正月十四日生〕。曾祖宗禧，祖玄璞，父復，母馮氏。慈侍下。兄友貞，弟友聞、統〔貢士〕。娶張氏。廣東鄉試第七十七名，會試第一百三十三名。

林璧〔貫湖廣寶慶府武岡州民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字廷美，行三，年三十三，九月十九日生〕。曾祖世富，祖用和〔知縣〕，父敏，母王氏。慈侍下。兄旭、暠，弟瑄、珎、瓊、瑩。娶方氏。湖廣鄉試第三十名，會試第九十三名。

孫緝〔貫江西南昌府豐城縣官籍，儒士，治《詩經》，字繼芳，行六，年二十五，三月初六日生〕。曾祖仲明〔贈右布政使〕，祖貞〔國子博士，贈右布政使〕，父曰良〔副都御史〕，母劉氏〔封夫人〕。具慶下。兄縝、約〔貢士〕、綽、綱〔貢士〕、綸。娶甘氏。江西鄉試第四十名，會試第二百九名。

石玉〔貫直隸真定府藁城縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字大器，行二，年二十九，十一月二十二日生〕。曾祖永，祖友智，父麟〔教諭〕，前母時氏，母徐氏。慈侍下。兄璽。娶趙氏。順天府鄉試第六十五名，會試第二百七十六名。
translation_en:
Yu Liang 余諒 [registered in a military household of Xinhui County, Guangzhou Prefecture, Guangdong; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yizhen, second in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-six, born on the fourteenth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Yu Zongxi, his grandfather was Yu Xuanpu, his father was Yu Fu, and his mother is née Feng. His mother is living. He has an elder brother Youzhen and younger brothers Youwen and Tong [Tribute Student (gongshi)]. He married Lady Zhang. He placed 77th in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and 133rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lin Bi 林璧 [registered in a civilian household of Wugang Subprefecture, Baoqing Prefecture, Huguang; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Tingmei, third in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-three, born on the nineteenth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Lin Shifu, his grandfather was Lin Yonghe [District Magistrate], his father was Lin Min, and his mother is née Wang. His mother is living. He has elder brothers Xu and Hao, and younger brothers Xuan, Zhen, Qiong, and Ying. He married Lady Fang. He placed 30th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 93rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Sun Ji 孫緝 [registered in an official household of Fengcheng County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi; a Confucian Scholar specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Jifang, sixth in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-five, born on the sixth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Sun Zhongming [posthumously honored as Right Administration Commissioner], his grandfather was Sun Zhen [Erudite in the Directorate of Education, posthumously honored as Right Administration Commissioner], his father is Sun Yueliang [Vice Censor-in-Chief], and his mother is née Liu [invested as Mistress of Imperially Bestowed Rank]. Both of his parents are living. He has elder brothers Zhen, Yue [Tribute Student], Chuo, Gang [Tribute Student], and Lun. He married Lady Gan. He placed 40th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 209th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shi Yu 石玉 [registered in a civilian household of Gaocheng County, Zhending Prefecture, Zhili; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Daqi, second in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-nine, born on the twenty-second day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Shi Yong, his grandfather was Shi Youzhi, his father was Shi Lin [Instructor], his father's first wife was née Shi, and his mother is née Xu. His mother is living. He has an elder brother Xi. He married Lady Zhao. He placed 65th in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination and 276th in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
樊瑩〔貫浙江衢州府常山縣民籍，縣學生，治《禮記》，字廷璧，行七，年三十一，正月初十日生〕。曾祖遜〔知事〕；祖温〔訓導〕；父文檢；母徐氏。嚴侍下。兄煌，弟璨。娶徐氏。浙江鄉試第十名，會試第七十八名。

毛志〔貫河南開封府陽武縣軍籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字尚忠，行一，年二十八，十二月二十四日生〕。曾祖麟；祖冲；父政；母史氏，繼母路氏。重慶下。弟懿、懋、恩、惠、憲。娶蘭氏。河南鄉試第五名，會試第一百二十五名。

張九疇〔貫狹西臨洮府狄道縣民籍，府學生，治《書經》，字天錫，行二，年二十一，十一月二十八日生〕。曾祖賢；祖傑；父安〔訓導〕；母韋氏。具慶下。兄元〔教諭〕，弟九韶、九德。娶陳氏。狹西鄉試第六名，會試第一百九十八名。

沈源〔貫福建漳州府龍溪縣民籍，縣學生，治《易經》，字澄之，行一，年四十，二月十六日生〕。曾祖文富；祖孟勛；父碩輩；母陳氏。重慶下。弟濫、渙、漙。娶□氏。福建鄉試第四十二名，會試第□□□名。
translation_en:
Fan Ying 樊瑩: Registered in a civilian household in Changshan County, Quzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang, he was a County Student specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji). His style name is Tingbi, he is seventh in seniority among his male cousins, and he is thirty-one years old, born on the tenth day of the first lunar month. His great-grandfather was Fan Xun ( Administrative Clerk), his grandfather was Fan Wen (Assistant Instructor), his father is Fan Wenjian, and his mother was Lady Xu. His father is living and his mother is deceased. He has an elder brother, Fan Huang, and a younger brother, Fan Can, and he is married to Lady Xu. He placed 10th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 78th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Mao Zhi 毛志: Registered in a military household in Yangwu County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan, he was a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji). His style name is Shangzhong, he is first in seniority, and he is twenty-eight years old, born on the twenty-fourth day of the twelfth lunar month. His great-grandfather was Mao Lin, his grandfather is Mao Chong, his father is Mao Zheng, his mother was Lady Shi, and his stepmother is Lady Lu. Both his parents and grandparents are living. He has younger brothers Mao Yi, Mao Mao, Mao En, Mao Hui, and Mao Xian, and he is married to Lady Lan. He placed 5th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 125th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Jiuchou 張九疇: Registered in a civilian household in Didao County, Lintao Prefecture, Shaanxi, he was a Prefectural Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing). His style name is Tianxi, he is second in seniority, and he is twenty-one years old, born on the twenty-eighth day of the eleventh lunar month. His great-grandfather was Zhang Xian, his grandfather was Zhang Jie, his father is Zhang An (Assistant Instructor), and his mother is Lady Wei. Both of his parents are living. He has an elder brother, Zhang Yuan (Instructor), and younger brothers Zhang Jiushao and Zhang Jiude, and he is married to Lady Chen. He placed 6th in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 198th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Yuan 沈源: Registered in a civilian household in Longxi County, Zhangzhou Prefecture, Fujian, he was a County Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing). His style name is Chengzhi, he is first in seniority, and he is forty years old, born on the sixteenth day of the second lunar month. His great-grandfather was Shen Wenfu, his grandfather is Shen Mengxun, his father is Shen Shuobei, and his mother is Lady Chen. Both his parents and grandparents are living. He has younger brothers Shen Lan, Shen Huan, and Shen Tuan, and he is married to Lady [?]. He placed 42nd in the Fujian Provincial Examination and [?] in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Mo Chang 莫昌, registered in a military household in Tongliang County, Chongqing Prefecture, Sichuan, was a [...] Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing). His courtesy name was Longyuan, he was the fifty-second in his generational line, and he was forty-two sui, born on the twenty-second day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was Mo Xinqing; his grandfather was Mo Zhongzhao, Instructor of this county; his father was Mo Shou; his mother was née Wang; and his stepmother was née Zhou. His father was deceased and his stepmother was living. His elder brothers were Mo Yongchang, Mo Yongfang, Mo Yongling, and Mo Yongfeng; his younger brother was Mo Yongzheng. He married née Fu. He placed thirty-third in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and fifty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yuan Jiang 袁江, registered in a civilian household in Xiangfu County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan, was an Added Student of the Prefectural School specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing). His courtesy name was Zimin, he was the seventh in his generational line, and he was twenty-two sui, born on the twenty-first day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Yuan Cheng; his grandfather was Yuan Jing; his father was Yuan Li; and his mother was née Wu. Both of his parents were living. His elder brothers were Yuan Fang, Yuan Ze, Yuan Qing, Yuan Hai, Yuan Shen, and Yuan Hong; his younger brother was Yuan Tong. He was betrothed to née Qiu. He placed seventy-first in the Henan Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Qing 武清, registered in a civilian household in Datong County, Datong Prefecture, Shanxi, was a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing). His courtesy name was Yuanjie, he was the fifth in his generational line, and he was thirty-three sui, born on the twenty-seventh day of the sixth month. His great-grandfather was Wu Yiqing; his grandfather was Wu Bingxing, posthumously honored as Right Assistant Administration Commissioner; his father was Wu Da, Right Administration Vice Commissioner of Guangxi; and his mother was née Liu, invested as Lady of Virtue. Both of his parents were deceased. His elder brothers were Wu He, Wu Cheng, Wu Ning (Prefect of Datong), and Wu Long; his younger brothers were Wu Heng and Wu Yu. He married née Li. He placed eighth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and two hundred forty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yuan Sheng 袁晟, registered in a civilian household in Shanyin County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, was a Prefectural School Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing). His courtesy name was Zhongzhao, he was the second in his generational line, and he was thirty-two sui, born on the twenty-fourth day of the third month. His great-grandfather was Yuan Zishao; his grandfather was Yuan Xianzong; his father was Yuan Jie; and his mother was née Zhao. Both of his parents were living. His elder brother was Yuan Yu. He married née Jin. He placed forty-fifth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and forty-[...] in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Chongzhi 王崇之 (registered in a civilian household of Hua County, Daming Prefecture, in the Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; an Added Student of the County School specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Shoujie, third in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-four, born on the twenty-fifth day of the intercalary tenth month). His great-grandfather was Wang Jingxin; his grandfather was Wang Xunli; his father was Wang Xian (Prefectural Vice Prefect); and his mother was née Zheng. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brothers are Wang Huai and Wang Ze, and his younger brothers are Wang Aizhi and Wang Jingzhi. He married née Zhou. He placed ninety-fourth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and two hundred thirty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cao Quan 曹銓 (registered in a military household of Mancheng County, Baoding Prefecture, in the Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; a National University Student specializing in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Bingheng, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty, born on the sixth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Cao Botong; his grandfather was Cao Bin; his father was Cao Duan (Instructor); and his mother is née Tian. His mother is living (his father having passed away). His younger brothers are Cao Rui, Cao Yue, Cao Yang, Cao Ao, and Cao Tang. He married née Wang. He placed one hundred seventeenth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and tenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fei Zhen 費臻 (registered in a civilian household of An Subprefecture, Baoding Prefecture, in the Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Shihe, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-four, born on the twenty-second day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Fei Yongguang; his grandfather was Fei Mao; his father is Fei Lian; his mother was née Zhong; and his stepmother is née Yu. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Fei Zhi 致 and Fei Zhi 郅. He married née Zeng. He placed twenty-eighth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and thirty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lin Rong 林榮 (registered in a military household of Panyu County, Guangzhou Prefecture, Guangdong; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Mengren, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty, born on the twenty-first day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Lin Qiao; his grandfather was Lin Yongxiu; his father is Lin Duan; and his mother is née Lu. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Lin Hua and Lin Shi. He married [two illegible characters]. He placed seventh in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and one hundred second in the Metropolitan Examination.

洪性〔貫湖廣長沙府攸縣軍籍，國子生，治《易經》，字萬善，行十三，年三十四，十一月二十三日生〕。曾祖原敬；祖德佐；父興邦；母朱氏。永感下。兄萬頃、萬里；弟萬勉、萬鈞、萬宜、萬璋、萬禎。娶龍氏。湖廣鄉試第二十九名，會試第二百三十七名。

李琮〔貫浙江景寧縣人，錦衣衛軍餘，治《易經》，字義方，行二，年二十三，七月十六日生〕。曾祖峻；祖信；父貴；母張氏；繼母高氏。具慶下。兄珎；弟瑞、玘、瑛、璿、琰、璜。聘石氏。順天府鄉試第四十名，會試第八十七名。

董齡〔貫山西汾州民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字壽卿，行一，年二十三，十月二十三日生〕。曾祖思中；祖從義；父志興；母李氏。具慶下。兄彪。娶陳氏。山西鄉試第十四名，會試第一百八十七名。
translation_en:
Yuan Qi 袁玘 [registered in Xingning County 興寧縣, Chenzhou 郴州, Huguang 湖廣; [5 illegible characters] student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); style name Tingyu 廷玉; seniority first; age thirty-three; born on the third day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Yuan Hua 華; his grandfather was Yuan Dexuan 德宣 [Registrar (jingli)]; his father was Yuan Daoli 道立; and his mother was née Lei 雷氏. His mother is living (cishixia). He married née Huang 黃氏. He placed twenty-seventh in the Huguang Provincial Examination and two hundred twenty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Hong Xing 洪性 [registered in a military household in You County 攸縣, Changsha Prefecture 長沙府, Huguang 湖廣; Directorate Student (guozisheng); specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); style name Wanshan 萬善; seniority thirteenth; age thirty-four; born on the twenty-third day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Hong Yuanjing 原敬; his grandfather was Hong Dezuo 德佐; his father was Hong Xingbang 興邦; and his mother was née Zhu 朱氏. Both of his parents are deceased (yongganxia). His elder brothers are Wanqing 萬頃 and Wanli 萬里; his younger brothers are Wanmian 萬勉, Wanjun 萬鈞, Wanyi 萬宜, Wanzhang 萬璋, and Wanzhen 萬禎. He married née Long 龍氏. He placed twenty-ninth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and two hundred thirty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Cong 李琮 [a native registered in Jingning County 景寧縣, Zhejiang 浙江; supernumerary soldier (junyu) of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard (Jinyiwei); specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); style name Yifang 義方; seniority second; age twenty-three; born on the sixteenth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Li Jun 峻; his grandfather was Li Xin 信; his father is Li Gui 貴; his mother was née Zhang 張氏; and his stepmother is née Gao 高氏. His father and stepmother are both living (juqingxia). His elder brother is Zhen 珎; his younger brothers are Rui 瑞, Qi 玘, Ying 瑛, Xuan 璿, Yan 琰, and Huang 璜. He is betrothed to née Shi 石氏. He placed fortieth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and eighty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Dong Ling 董齡 [registered in a civilian household in Fenzhou 汾州, Shanxi 山西; Directorate Student (guozisheng); specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Shouqing 壽卿; seniority first; age twenty-three; born on the twenty-third day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Dong Sizhong 思中; his grandfather was Dong Congyi 從義; his father is Dong Zhixing 志興; and his mother is née Li 李氏. Both of his parents are living (juqingxia). His elder brother is Biao 彪. He married née Chen 陳氏. He placed fourteenth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred eighty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

汪進〔貫直隸徽州府婺源縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《春秋》，字希顔，行五，年二十八，六月初六日生〕。曾祖用晦；祖為正；父棻；母張氏，繼母詹氏。具慶下。兄端、炬、炌、𤍤；弟嶹。娶吳氏。應天府鄉試第十名，會試第一百九十二名。

夏時〔貫直隸太倉衛軍籍，衛學軍生，治《詩經》，字用寅，行三，年三十八，九月十八日生〕。曾祖世隆；祖道昌；父德富；母陳氏。具慶下。兄聰、明；弟杲、瑢。娶韓氏。應天府鄉試第六十九名，會試第二百二十九名。

高岡〔貫遼東義州衛官籍，武生，治《詩經》，字鳴鳳，行三，年三十，七月初二日生〕。曾祖伯彦〔元樞密院判〕；祖德；父昱〔百戶〕；母于氏，繼母李氏。具慶下。兄宏〔百戶〕、富；弟岐。娶張氏。山東鄉試第六十四名，會試第二百五名。

馬誠〔貫四川成都府內江縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字純夫，行二，年四十，一月十五日生〕。曾祖文質；祖子高；父惟和；母陳氏。慈侍下。兄璠〔義官〕；弟軒、綸、輊、紘、誼。娶鍾氏，繼娶羅氏。四川鄉試第二十七名，會試第八十四名。
translation_en:
Wang Jin 汪進 [registered in a civilian household of Wuyuan County, Huizhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); an added student (zengguang sheng) of the County School; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Xiyan 希顔; fifth in seniority among his brothers; age twenty-eight, born on the sixth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Yonghui 用晦; his grandfather was Weizheng 為正; his father is Fen 棻; his mother was née Zhang 張, and his stepmother is née Zhan 詹. Both his father and stepmother are living. His elder brothers are Duan 端, Ju 炬, Kai 炌, and Ran 𤍤; his younger brother is Dao 嶹. He married née Wu 吳. He placed tenth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xia Shi 夏時 [registered in a military household of the Taicang Guard, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); a military student (junsheng) of the Guard School; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yongyin 用寅; third in seniority among his brothers; age thirty-eight, born on the eighteenth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Shilong 世隆; his grandfather was Daochang 道昌; his father is Defu 德富; his mother is née Chen 陳. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Cong 聰 and Ming 明; his younger brothers are Gao 杲 and Rong 瑢. He married née Han 韓. He placed sixty-ninth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and two hundred twenty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Gao Gang 高岡 [registered in an official household of the Yizhou Guard in Liaodong; a military student (wusheng); specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Mingfeng 鳴鳳; third in seniority among his brothers; age thirty, born on the second day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Boyan 伯彦 [Assistant Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs under the Yuan dynasty]; his grandfather was De 德; his father is Yu 昱 [Company Commander]; his mother was née Yu 于, and his stepmother is née Li 李. Both his father and stepmother are living. His elder brothers are Hong 宏 [Company Commander] and Fu 富; his younger brother is Qi 岐. He married née Zhang 張. He placed sixty-fourth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and two hundred fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ma Cheng 馬誠 [registered in a civilian household of Neijiang County, Chengdu Prefecture, Sichuan; a Directorate Student (guozisheng); specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Chunfu 純夫; second in seniority among his brothers; age forty, born on the fifteenth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Wenzhi 文質; his grandfather was Zigao 子高; his father was Weihe 惟和; his mother is née Chen 陳. His mother is living. His elder brother is Fan 璠 [Honorary Official]; his younger brothers are Xuan 軒, Lun 綸, Zhi 輊, Hong 紘, and Yi 誼. He married née Zhong 鍾, and remarried née Luo 羅. He placed twenty-seventh in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and eighty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

蕭噐用〔貫江西吉安府泰和縣儒籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字廷瑞，行一，年三十四，十二月初六日生〕。曾祖子凱，祖嗣虬，父素〔教授〕，母胡氏。重慶下。弟噐溫、噐成。娶梁氏。順天府鄉試第一百一名，會試第二百三十六名。

translation_en:
Liang Han 梁翰 (registered in a military household in Didao County 狄道縣, Lintao Prefecture 臨洮府, Shaanxi; Prefectural Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Zongwen 宗文; fourth in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the thirteenth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Liang Heng 衡, his grandfather was Liang Yong 庸, his father was Liang Cai 才, his mother was née Bian 邊氏, and his stepmother was née Wen 文氏. Both his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Liang Tan 潭, Liang Hu 滸, and Liang Zhan 湛; his younger brothers are Liang Jun 濬, Liang Ying 潆, Liang Run 潤, Liang Zi 滋, Liang Yan 演, and Liang Xiang 湘. He married née Wei 魏氏. He ranked thirteenth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and two hundred and forty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiao Qiyong 蕭噐用 (registered in a Confucian scholar household in Taihe County 泰和縣, Ji'an Prefecture 吉安府, Jiangxi; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Tingrui 廷瑞; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the sixth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Xiao Zikai 子凱, his grandfather was Xiao Siqiu 嗣虬, his father is Xiao Su 素 (Prefectural Instructor of Schools), and his mother is née Hu 胡氏. Both his grandparents and parents are living. His younger brothers are Xiao Qiwen 噐溫 and Xiao Qicheng 噐成. He married née Liang 梁氏. He ranked one hundred and first in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and two hundred and thirty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cao Hong 曹宏 (native of Jurong County 句容縣, Yingtian Prefecture 應天府, registered in a hereditary military officer household of the Embroidered-uniform Guard; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Weiyu 維裕; first in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the sixth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Cao Guicheng 貴成, his grandfather is Cao Anshan 安善, his father is Cao Zheng 政 (Company Commander), his mother was née Chang 暢氏, and his stepmother is née Ma 馬氏. Both his grandparents and parents are living. His younger brothers are Cao Rong 容, Cao Xuan 宣, Cao Ding 定, Cao Yi 宜, Cao Shi 實, Cao Bin 賓, Cao Yu 寓, and Cao Huan 寰. He married née He 何氏. He ranked fifty-second in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and forty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xue Chen 薛諶 (registered in a civilian household in Hejin County 河津縣, Pingyang Prefecture 平陽府, Shanxi; Added Student of the County School; specialized in the Classic of History; courtesy name Yuanyan 元言; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the twenty-second day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Xue Zhen 貞 (posthumously honoured as Chief Minister of the Court of Judicial Review), his grandfather is Xue Xuan 瑄 (Left Vice Minister of Rites concurrently Serving as Hanlin Academician), his father is Xue Pu 溥, and his mother is née Chang 暢氏. Both his grandparents and parents are living. His younger brothers are Xue You 祐, Xue Li 禮, and Xue Hu 祜. He married née Qiao 喬氏. He ranked eleventh in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred and [?][?]th in the Metropolitan Examination.

葉贄〔貫直隸淮安府山陽縣軍籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字崇禮，行四，年二十六，八月初九日生〕。曾祖子高，祖邦和，父本道，母祝氏。重慶下。兄贇、貴、蘭，弟資、贊、質、寶、貫、貢。娶高氏。應天府鄉試第二十五名，會試第五名。

龍晟〔貫湖廣武昌府蒲圻縣軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字德輝，行五，年三十八，正月十二日生〕。曾祖茂華，祖文質，父濟，母曾氏。具慶下。兄旺〔義官〕、昊，弟景、冕、昻、曇。娶黃氏。湖廣鄉試第十七名，會試第一百九十九名。

俞藎〔貫浙江嚴州府桐廬縣民籍，縣學生，治《書經》，字廷臣，行十，年三十五，閏十二月初十日生〕。曾祖文益，祖仲彬，父宗政，母方氏。慈侍下。兄景暘〔義官〕、景彰、景竒，弟景淵、景和。娶張氏。浙江鄉試第二名，會試第一百二十七名。

林誠〔貫福建興化府莆田縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字貴實，行一，年三十九，六月初五日生〕。曾祖嗣仁〔贈員外郎〕，祖英〔兵部員外郎〕，父輝〔甲辰進士〕，母吳氏。慈侍下。兄志，弟純、德、經、綖、繡。娶宋氏，繼娶楊氏，再繼娶陳氏。福建鄉試第一百三十六名，會試第一百八十二名。
translation_en:
Ye Zhi 葉贄 (registered in Shanyang County 山陽縣, Huai'an Prefecture 淮安府, Directly Attached Territory [Zhili 直隸], under a military household registration; National University Student [guozisheng 國子生]; specialized in the Record of Rites [Liji 禮記]; courtesy name Chongli 崇禮; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the ninth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Ye Zigao 子高, his grandfather was Ye Banghe 邦和, his father is Ye Bendao 本道, and his mother is Lady Zhu 祝氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brothers are Ye Yun 贇, Ye Gui 貴, and Ye Lan 蘭; his younger brothers are Ye Zi 資, Ye Zan 贊, Ye Zhi 質, Ye Bao 寶, Ye Guan 貫, and Ye Gong 貢. He is married to Lady Gao 高氏. He placed twenty-fifth in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Long Sheng 龍晟 (registered in Puqi County 蒲圻縣, Wuchang Prefecture 武昌府, Huguang 湖廣, under a military household registration; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing 詩經]; courtesy name Dehui 德輝; fifth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-eight, born on the twelfth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Long Maohua 茂華, his grandfather was Long Wenzhi 文質, his father is Long Ji 濟, and his mother is Lady Zeng 曾氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Long Wang 旺 (Honorary Official [yiguan 義官]) and Long Hao 昊; his younger brothers are Long Jing 景, Long Mian 冕, Long Ang 昻, and Long Tan 曇. He is married to Lady Huang 黃氏. He placed seventeenth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yu Jin 俞藎 (registered in Tonglu County 桐廬縣, Yanzhou Prefecture 嚴州府, Zhejiang 浙江, under a civilian household registration; County School Student [xianxuesheng 縣學生]; specialized in the Classic of Documents [Shujing 書經]; courtesy name Tingchen 廷臣; tenth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the tenth day of the intercalary twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Yu Wenyi 文益, his grandfather was Yu Zhongbin 仲彬, his father was Yu Zongzheng 宗政, and his mother is Lady Fang 方氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Yu Jingyang 景暘 (Honorary Official), Yu Jingzhang 景彰, and Yu Jingqi 景竒; his younger brothers are Yu Jingyuan 景淵 and Yu Jinghe 景和. He is married to Lady Zhang 張氏. He placed second in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lin Cheng 林誠 (registered in Putian County 莆田縣, Xinghua Prefecture 興化府, Fujian 福建, under a civilian household registration; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents; courtesy name Guishi 貴實; first in seniority in his line; aged thirty-nine, born on the fifth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Lin Siren 嗣仁 (posthumously honoured as Vice Director [yuanwailang 員外郎]), his grandfather was Lin Ying 英 (Vice Director in the Ministry of War [bingbu yuanwailang 兵部員外郎]), his father was Lin Hui 輝 (metropolitan graduate [jinshi 進士] of the jiachen year [1424]), and his mother is Lady Wu 吳氏. His mother is living. His elder brother is Lin Zhi 志; his younger brothers are Lin Chun 純, Lin De 德, Lin Jing 經, Lin Yan 綖, and Lin Xiu 繡. He was married to Lady Song 宋氏, remarried to Lady Yang 楊氏, and married a third time to Lady Chen 陳氏. He placed one hundred thirty-sixth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and one hundred eighty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Qiao [?]jun 喬□鈞 (registered in a civilian household of Queshan County 確山縣, Runing Prefecture 汝寧府, Henan 河南; Student of the Directorate of Imperial Academy [guozisheng]; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; style name Shuduan 叔端; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the thirteenth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Qiao Shengzu 喬勝祖; his grandfather was Qiao Bigui 喬必貴; his father was Qiao Da 喬達 (invested as Supervising Secretary of the Office of Scrutiny for Personnel); his mother was née Pan 潘 (invested as Child Nurturess [ruren]). His mother is living. His elder brother is Qiao Qi 喬玘 (Supervising Secretary of the Office of Scrutiny for War); his younger brother is Qiao Zhang 喬章. He married née Wang 王. He placed fourth in the Henan Provincial Examination and two hundred forty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wen Cong 温琮 (registered in a civilian household of Huayang County 華陽縣, Chengdu Prefecture 成都府, Sichuan 四川; Student of the Directorate of Imperial Academy; specialized in the Record of Rites [Liji]; style name Tingrui 廷瑞; fifth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the third day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Wen Zicheng 温子成 (Department Magistrate); his grandfather was Wen Liang 温良 (Sacrificer); his father is Wen Yanzhong 温彥中 (Physician); his mother is née Mao 茅. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Wen Li 温理 (Tribute Student [gongshi]), Wen Qi 温玘, Wen Chen 温琛, and Wen Yuan 温瑗; his younger brothers are Wen Qi 温琦, Wen Xi 温璽, Wen Lian 温璉, and Wen Bi 温璧. He married née Gao 高. He placed second in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and one hundred fifty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yu Dajie 于大節 (a native of Jinxian County 進賢縣, Jiangxi 江西, registered in a civilian household of Renqiu County 任丘縣, Zhili 直隸; Prefectural Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; style name Shouzheng 守正; sixth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the twelfth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Yu Jinwen 于晉文; his grandfather was Yu Yuanfang 于元方; his father is Yu Shangjing 于尚京; his legal mother is née Che 車, and his birth mother is née Qiu 丘. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Yu Damo 于大謨, Yu Dayong 于大用, Yu Dalun 于大倫, Yu Dachang 于大常, and Yu Daben 于大本. He married née Zhang 張. He placed one hundred thirty-third in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and two hundred forty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Zhang 柳彰 (registered in a civilian household of Haiyang County 海陽縣, Chaozhou Prefecture 潮州府, Guangdong 廣東; Added-quota Student of the County School; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; style name Tingxian 廷顯; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the ninth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Liu Yue 柳悅; his grandfather was Liu You 柳佑; his father is Liu Yu 柳裕; his mother was née Wu 吳. His father is living. His younger brothers are Liu Bin 柳彬, Liu Yu 柳彧 (Tribute Student [gongshi]), and Liu Mu 柳穆. He married née Dai 戴. He placed sixty-second in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and two hundred thirty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Zhang Lian 張璉 [registered in a saltern household in Anyi County, Pingyang Prefecture, Shanxi; a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Tingyu; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-eighth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Delin; his grandfather was Zhang Juyi; his father is Zhang Yuanji, and his mother is née Gao. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Zhang Ying and Zhang Xun; his younger brothers are Zhang Xiu, Zhang Fan [Directorate Student], and Zhang Sui [Directorate Student]. Zhang Lian married née Ge. He placed fifty-first in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and twenty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Mingfeng 李鳴鳳 [registered in a civilian household in Dingxing County, Baoding Prefecture, Metropolitan Area (Zhili); a Directorate Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Shiyang; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-five, born on the sixth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Shicheng [posthumously honored as Office Manager of the Rear Chief Military Commission]; his grandfather was Li Fu [Assistant Surveillance Commissioner of Shanxi]; his father is Li Jun [Surveillance Commissioner of Shaanxi], and his mother is née Zhang [invested as Child Nurturess]. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Li Xiangfeng [tribute scholar (gongshi)] and Li Yifeng; his younger brothers are Li Qifeng, Li Laifeng, Li Guanfeng, Li Wufeng, Li Gangfeng, and Li Shaofeng. He married née Wei. He placed one hundred and first in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and two hundredth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Wenzhao 張文昭 [registered in Pingshan Guard, Shandong; a Student of the Dongchang Prefectural School specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yingkui; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-second day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Kaiyi; his grandfather was Zhang Yuanzhen; his father is Zhang Gui, and his mother is née Lan. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Zhang Wenhao and Zhang Wenye. He married née Dai. He placed fifty-eighth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and two hundred and third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Feng Xu 馮續 [registered in a military household in Changyi County, Pingdu Subprefecture, Laizhou Prefecture, Shandong; a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Chengzong; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the twentieth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Feng Yanli; his grandfather was Feng Jing; his father is Feng Qi [Vice Magistrate], and his mother is née Zhang. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Feng Run, Feng Hong, and Feng Ze; his younger brothers are Feng Ji, Feng Lun, and Feng Xu. He married née Yan. He placed fortieth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and one hundred and ninety-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Chen Zhongshu 陳仲舒 [registered under a civilian household in Ba County, Chongqing Prefecture, Sichuan; County School Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Xixian; fifth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the twenty-eighth day of the sixth month]: His great-grandfather was Chen Jinghe, his grandfather was Chen Youbin, his father is Chen Zan, and his mother is née Zhou. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brothers are Chen Zhongji, Chen Zhongjie, Chen Zhongkun, and Chen Zhongwen, and his younger brother is Chen Zhongqi. He married née Jiang. He placed second in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 110th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Sheng 許盛 [registered under a saltern household in Pinghu County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; Directorate Student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Changshi; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the twenty-first day of the sixth month]: His great-grandfather was Xu Boling, his grandfather was Xu Zhong, his father is Xu Xin, and his mother is née Shu. Both his parents are living. His elder brother is Xu Mao. He married née Wang. He placed 63rd in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Heng 王衡 [registered under a Confucian scholar household in Jishan County, Jiang Subprefecture, Pingyang Prefecture, Shanxi; County School Student; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Zongquan; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-four, born on the twenty-eighth day of the first month]: His great-grandfather was Wang Lidao, his grandfather was Wang Gui, his father was Wang Qi [Assistant Instructor], his legal mother is née Duan, and his birth mother is née Han. His mother is living (his father having died). His elder brothers are Wang Mianzhe, Wang Mianshan [Honorary Official], and Wang Mianxin, and his younger brother is Wang Mianyi. He married née Duan. He placed second in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 105th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shao Kui 邵奎 [registered under an official household in Jinzhou Guard, Liaodong; Directorate Student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Wenming; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the fourth day of the second month]: His great-grandfather was Shao Junyi, his grandfather was Shao Daju, his father was Shao Ying, and his mother is née Wang. His mother is living (his father having died). His elder brother is Shao Xiao. He married née Xu. He placed 56th in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 54th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xing Gan 邢幹 (Originally from Yishui County, Shandong, registered under an official household in the Lin'an Guard, Yunnan; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Bingzhong; sixth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the fifth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Xing Quan (Battalion Commander), his grandfather was Xing Qi (Battalion Commander), his father was Xing Kui, his father's former wife was née Pu, and his mother is née Jiang. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Xing Duan, Xing Kai, Xing Zheng, Xing Ang, and Xing Jian, and his younger brother is Xing En. He is married to née Zhu. He placed third in the Yunnan Provincial Examination and one hundred eighty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lin Pin 林玭 (Registered in a civilian household in Houguan County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Tingzhen; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the eleventh day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Lin Yang, his grandfather was Lin Xinren, his father is Lin Xiu, his father's former wife was née Ding, and his mother is née Zhou. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Lin Tingqi (Assistant Instructor), and his younger brothers are Lin Cheng, Lin Zhang, Lin Lin, Lin Zhen (Tribute Student), Lin Qi, Lin Yang, Lin Tang, Lin Xu, and Lin Qiu. He married née Xue, and remarried née Quan. He placed ninety-third in the Fujian Provincial Examination and third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Gui 徐珪 (Registered in a military household in Anyue County, Tongchuan Subprefecture, Sichuan; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Guoxin; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the seventh day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Xu Bicai, his grandfather is Xu Wenxue, his father is Xu Xiao, and his mother is née Pang. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brother is Xu Fengxiang. He is married to née Yan. He placed twenty-fourth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and thirty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tan Qing 譚慶 (Registered in a civilian household in Shanzhou, Henan Prefecture, Henan; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Zongshan; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the ninth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was [illegible], his grandfather was Tan Qing, his father is Tan Yuan (Assistant Granary Commissioner), his father's former wife was née Zhang, and his mother is née Li. His [parents' status is illegible]. His [brothers are illegible]. He is married to [illegible]. He placed [illegible in the Provincial Examination] and [illegible] in the Metropolitan Examination.
